title: Clipping of article "The Kennedy Murder and the Secret Services of the USA"
summary: Routing sheet regarding an article titled 'The Kennedy Murder and the Secret Services of the USA' from the Italian Communist Party weekly Rinascita, which references rumors suggesting the Agency organized President Kennedy's murder.

title: DISCUSSION BETWEEN MEMBER SR DIVISION CONCERNING OSWALD'S STAY IN HELSINKI.
summary: Discussion between a member of the SR Division and CoS Helsinki concerning Oswald's stay in Helsinki, including his contact with the Soviet Consulate there. The document includes information about the timetable of Oswald's stay in Finland in October 1959, travel times, and passenger list retention policies.

title: DISCUSSION between members SR Division, and CoS Helsinki concerning timetable OF OSWALD'S stay in Finland and Helsinki
summary: Memo for the record documenting a discussion between SR Division members and the CoS Helsinki concerning the timetable of Lee Harvey Oswald's stay in Finland and Helsinki in October 1959, including his contact with the Soviet Consulate. The discussion includes details on travel times, consulate hours, and airport passenger list retention policies.

title: MEMO FOR THE RECORD
summary: Memo for the record regarding Warren Commission inquiry concerning the timetable of Oswald's stay in Finland in October 1959, including his contact with the Soviet Consulate there.

title: Discussion with Warren Commission Staff Member
summary: Memorandum regarding a discussion with Warren Commission staff member W. David Slawson concerning inconsistencies between CIA and State Department information on Soviet emigration policies and the Oswalds' departure from the USSR.

title: KIGREST TRACES JOACHIM JOESTER
recipient: BONN, FRANKFURT, BERLIN, COPENHAGEN, REYKJAVIK, PARIS, STOCKHOLM DIRECTOR THE HAGUE BRUSSELS
summary: This cable discusses Joachim Joesten, a writer with possible ties to communist organizations and anti-KUBARK sentiments. It requests a thorough check of his background, writings, and possible connections, including his fiancee Anna Schinsky. The matter is of interest to the Warren Commission.

title: Name Check and Consolidation Request for Roman Fedorovich D'EDKOV and Vilasa Nikolaevna D'EDKOV
summary: Request to check records for Roman Fedorovich D'EDKOV and Vilasa Nikolaevna D'EDKOV, applicants for entry visas to India, with Roman scheduled to be an English teacher at the Soviet Embassy in New Delhi.

title: Warren Commission Testimony - Selected Excerpts
recipient: Chiefs of all Stations, Chief, KUDOVE
summary: This dispatch transmits excerpts from Warren Commission testimony to various CIA stations and headquarters divisions, focusing on Presidential protection and interagency cooperation. It instructs officers in senior positions to review the material.

title: Field and HQS Distribution - BD #5847
summary: This document is a distribution list of field and headquarters divisions.

title: Letter regarding Warren Commission document CD-971
summary: Letter from Richard Helms to Sir Charles C. F. Spry regarding the declassification of Warren Commission document CD-971. Helms mentions that there is no intention to release CD-971 and that Spry's points provide every reason to keep the document out of the public domain.

title: Valeriy Vladimirovich Kostikov Activities
summary: This memo discusses Valeriy Vladimirovich Kostikov's activities, including his tours in Mexico City, attempts to cultivate a U.S. Government employee, handling Lee Harvey Oswald's visa request, and alleged involvement with Central American communist parties. It also mentions his unusual trips to Moscow and Havana, his sudden departure from Mexico, and his reputation as an effective intelligence officer.

title: VALERIY VLADIMIROVICH KOSTIKOV
summary: This memo discusses Valeriy Vladimirovich Kostikov, a KGB officer who may have been involved with Lee Harvey Oswald in Mexico City. It requests information on Kostikov's activities in Mexico and Beirut, as well as his potential involvement in recent threats and violence against the Embassy in Beirut.

title: Correspondence regarding Sergyj Czornonoh's claims about Lee Harvey Oswald
summary: This document contains correspondence regarding Sergyj Czornonoh's claims about providing information on Lee Harvey Oswald to US officials in 1963 and his allegations of subsequent harassment and drugging.

title: Field Distribution
summary: This document lists the distribution of materials to various divisions and locations, including WH Division, NE Division, BD, EUR Division, FE Division, SB Division, and internal distributions.

title: Letter for Director from Sir Charles Spry (ASIO)
summary: This document concerns the declassification of Warren Commission document CD-971, which refers to an investigation of anonymous telephone calls to the Canberra Embassy before and after the assassination of President Kennedy. Sir Charles Spry recommends against declassification.

title: Letter re: Declassification of Warren Commission Document CD-071
summary: Letter from Richard Helms to Sir Charles C. F. Spry regarding the declassification of Warren Commission document CD-071.

title: RELEASE OF CLASSIFIED DOCUMENT
classification: John F. Kennedy Assassination Records Act of 1992
summary: This document discusses the release of a classified document related to Lee Harvey Oswald. It mentions a fax received that appears incomplete, including a cover sheet, a cable stating "NO TRACES," and the first page of a Director cable requesting traces on Lee Harvey Oswald. The document also discusses the deletion of crypts and informing the ambassador and liaison service chiefs about the release date.

title: KGB Official Nikonov
summary: Cable discusses KGB Official Nikonov, grandson of Vyacheslav Molotov, and his new role as Deputy to KGB Director Bakatin. Nikonov reviewed KGB files on Lee Harvey Oswald and found no evidence of Oswald being a KGB agent. Nikonov also inquired into the fate of Raoul Wallenberg.

title: DIR INFO CNBR CITE MELB 2517
summary: Cable regarding preliminary checks on recorded conversations revealing information about a dark blue Buick, license plates, and individuals mentioned in previous communications. Mentions arrangements with PMG Liasion Officer Ted Young to trace further calls.

title: The 201 System
summary: This document is Annex B of Chapter III from CSHB 70-1-1, dated November 15, 1974, which details the 201 system used by the Operations Directorate for identifying, controlling, and filing information about persons of interest. It outlines the 201 number, dossier, master record, main index reference, and OI codes. The document also describes procedures for opening, maintaining, purging, charging, restricting, and canceling 201 dossiers, as well as requesting information and machine listings.

title: CIA Special Collection: Report on JMWAVE's Relationship with ANCARBON-1
summary: This dispatch details JMWAVE's relationship with AMCARBON-1, a contact at The Miami Herald, from December 1962 to March 1964. It covers the operational support, intelligence, and propaganda activities involving AMCARBON-1, and requests a 201 number be assigned.

title: Delegates to Youth Festival in Berlin
recipient: Washington, Caracas, Guatemala City, Havana, Quito, Maracaibo, Guayaquil
summary: Report from Bogota regarding delegates to the Youth Festival in Berlin, August-September 1961. Information obtained from a local detective, who received a report from an informant in Paris concerning activities of the Colombian delegation and other countries' delegates. Includes names and comments on delegates from Guatemala, Venezuela, Ecuador, and Cuba.

title: Highlights of Tape-Recorded Conversation in Miami Between Mr. William D. Pawley and an Unidentified Cuban during Period 17-18 October
summary: William Pawley discusses with an unidentified Cuban the possibility of U.S. support for anti-Castro groups, their need for moral backing and funds, and the fragmented state of the Cuban resistance.

title: GENERAL- Operational. SPECIFIC PAWLEY Business Interests in the Dominican Republic
summary: Dispatch regarding William D. PAWLEY's business interests in the Dominican Republic, including mineral exploitation, purchase of Hotel Hamaca, and a concession for Dominican postage stamps managed by Edward P. PAWLEY.

title: THE LEE HARVEY OSWALD CASE #351164
summary: This memo discusses the involvement of Abram Chayes and Samuel Wise in the Lee Harvey Oswald case, including their roles in Oswald's return to the United States from the Soviet Union, Chayes' security clearance for liaison contact, and Wise's past association with individuals of questionable loyalty.

title: ANNEX B THE 201 SYSTEM
summary: This document outlines the 201 system, a method for identifying individuals of interest to the Operations Directorate, controlling information about them, and producing lists based on various categories. It details the 201 number, dossier, master record, OI codes, and procedures for opening, maintaining, and canceling 201 dossiers, including restrictions and information requests.

title: Contact Report/ITAMII-9
summary: Contact reports of meetings with LI TAMIL-9 on 17 and 29 July 1963, including information on Cuban celebrations, embassy employee transactions, and potential recruitment targets.

title: Robert West Pugh Covert Security Approval and Investigation
summary: This collection of documents pertains to the covert security approval and subsequent investigation of Robert West Pugh, who was considered for a position as a First Officer in the Far East under Project HBILKA/JBGREED. The documents detail the initial approval, concerns raised regarding Pugh's past drinking problem and his brother's alleged communist associations, and the eventual cancellation of his employment following his resignation.

title: MEMORANDUM FOR THE RECORD - OSWALD-Nosenko
summary: Memorandum regarding aspects of Nosenko's information on the Oswald case, specifically concerning Irina Shurakova's activities and reaction to the Oswald display at a wax museum.

title: Report on Antonio RODRIGUES Echanabal
summary: Report on Antonio RODRIGUES Echanabal. Includes biographical information, diplomatic postings, and defection from the Cuban government. Requests debriefing results from French authorities.

title: List of HMYA and MAYA Files Related to Mexican Operations and Individuals
summary: This document contains a list of various HMYA and MAYA files related to different operations, propaganda, correspondence, and individuals in Mexico. It also includes information on projects like LIRULE, LIRAZBIT, and LIVACATE, as well as references to PCM activities, KAPOK receipts, and political actions.

title: WOMUSE: 'Peace' Demonstrations
summary: This dispatch concerns the Catholic Association for International Peace (CAIP) and its activities, including 'Peace' Demonstrations and its 40th Annual Conference on 'Selective Conscientious Objection in an Age of Conflict.' Oliver H. CORBUSTON joined CAIP for cover purposes and provided the materials.

title: RYBAT MIPASHA REDTOP - Beheiren and the Four U.S. Navy Deserters
recipient: Chief, Sov Bloc Div; Chief, Far East Division; Chief, WOMUSE/ICG
summary: This dispatch from the Chief of Station in Tokyo details the activities of BEHEIREN, a Japanese anti-Vietnam War organization, and its involvement in the defection of four U.S. Navy sailors to the USSR. It outlines the organization's structure, key figures, and connections with Soviet officials and U.S. pacifist groups. The document also discusses BEHEIREN's propaganda efforts and the potential impact of the defection case on the organization's growth and influence.

title: Ramon Joseph ALVAREZ Durant and Project LIEMPTY Operations
summary: This document details the activities of Ramon Joseph ALVAREZ Durant and related personnel involved in Project LIEMPTY, a photo surveillance operation targeting the Soviet Embassy from 1955 to 1972. It outlines ALVAREZ's role as a cutout and photo technician, as well as the involvement of other individuals like Hester ROOS (LIEMPTY-19), Oliver G. SCANTLING (Juan N. FRAIS-RAMIRRZ), and Jorge Barcello VILLAGRAn Alvarez (LIEMPTY-6). The report also describes the setup and function of the various basehouses (LIMITED, LILYRIC, LICALLA) used for surveillance.

title: RELEASE UNDER THE PRESIDENT JOHN F. KENNEDY ASSASSINATION RECORDS ACT OF 1992
classification: John F. Kennedy Assassination Records Act of 1992
summary: This document discusses the U.S. House of Representatives Select Committee on Assassinations' investigation into the assassinations of President Kennedy and Dr. Martin Luther King, focusing on leads in Portugal, the UK, and Mexico related to James Earl Ray. The committee seeks assistance from Portuguese National Police and access to their files. The CIA is cooperating with the committee but prefers overt functions to be handled by LEGATTS or others publicly identifiable.

title: OTS (late TSD) and Jim McCord's Cuban Activities; Summary of STESCALADE - Audio Operation Against the New China News Agency in Havana; RELEASE CONTINGENCY OPLAN 62-2
sender: RUDOLPH E. GOMEZ, Acting Chief, WH; RICHARD I. SKINNER
summary: These documents discuss covert operations related to the New China News Agency in Havana and contingency plans for the release and repatriation of TSD employees arrested in Cuba.

title: ROKETING
summary: This cable discusses a telephone conversation regarding a possible Soviet government connection to the assassination and assigns responsibility for contact with a Polish driver to KUBARK.

title: Request permission to train LEGROUP-1
summary: This document discusses training and permission requests related to operations. It references LEGROUP-1, SM Match $23209, and Developer $22669. It involves training INROUP-6 to use Match.

title: FIOPP Seminar in Mexico City; Request for Traces on Cuban Attendees
recipient: DDP, CI/OPS, CA 2, CA/PEG, CA/PROP, FI, FI/INT 2, WH 7, SAS 8, WR
summary: Cable discussing the Federacion Interamericana de Organizaciones de Periodistas Profesionales (FIOPP) seminar in Mexico City and requesting traces on attendees from the Colegio Nacional de Periodistas de la Republica de Cuba (in exile).

title: Reported Use of Yacht Potomac by Alpha 66
summary: This memo discusses a report regarding the potential use of the yacht Potomac by the Alpha 66 organization for transporting weapons. An unsolicited phone call to LAFO reported the vessel was taking on a cargo of weapons crated as Argentine beef, and destined to leave soon for Seattle. The informant identified Wes Davis and Cliff Roberts as being on board.

title: Robert Prachett/ Cuban Counterrevolutionary Group, Alpha-66
summary: Memorandum from the Chief of the New York Office to the Chief of the Contact Division regarding Robert Prachett, a US citizen with contacts in the Cuban counterrevolutionary group Alpha-66, and his potential use as a source of information.

title: Cuban Refugee Group
summary: Memorandum from the Chief of the Minneapolis Office to the Chief of the Contact Division regarding a Cuban refugee group and their activities. The memo discusses providing assistance to the group in exchange for agency control and includes a list of key individuals involved in shuttling supplies and people between Cuba and the US.

title: Specific Information concerning Lam A
summary: This document contains specific information concerning Lam A, including a description of the subject, their activities during the war, and their involvement in various operations.

title: Operational/GYROSE Agreed Activities
summary: This dispatch discusses agreed activities between JMWAVE and ACSI, including refugee referral procedures, infiltration operations, and coordination of resources like W/T assets and secret writing. It also highlights concerns about cooperation from Lt. Col. Causes and potential issues at the Opa Locka center.

title: Information Council of the Americas (INCA) and Truth Tapes Program
recipient: Chief, Contact Division; Att'n: Nonsov Bloc Area
summary: This memo discusses the Information Council of the Americas (INCA) and its Truth Tapes program aimed at combating Communist penetration in Latin America. It details interactions with Edward Scannell Butler, INCA's Executive Vice President, and explores the potential of INCA's correspondence files as a source of information on radio broadcasting stations in Latin America. The memo also seeks input on additional topics for INCA's questionnaire to gather technical information about the stations.

title: Current Address of Maurice Halperin
summary: This document discusses the current address of Maurice Halperin, who is believed to be living in Havana, Cuba. The information was obtained from a source who received a Christmas card from Halperin. The document highlights Halperin's past activities and associations.

title: Review and Analysis of AMFAUNA Operation
summary: This dispatch discusses the AMFAUNA operation, focusing on AMFAUNA-1, a Cuban national recruited and trained in the United States who returned to Cuba to serve as a resident agent in Havana. The document details his operational methods, security precautions, communications, finances, sub-agents, background, motivation, and previous history of the operation from January 1961 to April 1962.

title: International Institute for Peace
summary: This document is a report from an Israeli liaison detailing Latin American public figures who signed an appeal to convene the Latin-American Conference for National Sovereignty, Economic Emancipation, and Peace in Mexico in March 1961. It lists signatories from Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Cuba, Honduras, Mexico, Peru, Puerto Rico, and Salvador.

title: Case 9145: Research Institute of America and Covert Operations
sender: Lea, Ashcraft, Support (Coleman), Support (Travis), McCann, Millard
summary: This collection of documents pertains to Case 9145, involving the Research Institute of America and Leo Cherne's cooperation with the CIA to provide cover for agents. The documents detail arrangements for meetings, background information on William J. Acom, and the extent of Cherne's involvement in backstopping the cover story.

title: WOMUSE: "Peace" Demonstrations
summary: This document discusses 'Peace' Demonstrations and the Catholic Association for International Peace (CAIP). It includes information on literature mailed by CAIP to its members concerning "Negotiation Now!" and its 40th Annual Conference, which is themed "Selective Conscientious Objection in an Age of Conflict."

title: Transmittal of Reports
summary: This dispatch contains reports and notes from TERLAUP regarding operational and intelligence matters. It also discusses the preliminary debriefing of THERIAULT, including financial arrangements, the possibility of developing an interest in Krishna Menon, and an invitation to visit the U.S. Additionally, it includes general comments on the Ford Foundation's work in India, Evelyn Hersey's role, and the Delhi Training and Orientation Centre. The dispatch also touches on Communist organization of domestic workers in New Delhi and the State Department's policy on visits to China.

title: Information Concerning Suspect in Martin Luther King Jr. Assassination
recipient: Asuncion, Bangkok, Barcelona, Beirut, Berlin, Bern, Bogota, Brasilia, Brussels, Buenos Aires, Caracas, Copenhagen, Frankfurt, Geneva, Georgetown, Guatemala City, Guayaquil, The Hague, Hamburg, Helsinki, Hong Kong, Kingston, La Paz, Lima, London, Madrid, Managua, Montevideo, New Delhi, Lisbon, Manila, Munich, Oslo, Panama City, Paris, Port Au Prince, Port of Spain, Porto Alegre, Quito, Recife, Rawalpindi, Rio de Janeiro, Rome, San Jose, Santo Domingo, San Salvador, Santiago, Santiago de los Caballeros, São Paulo, Stockholm, Tegucigalpa, Tokyo, Vienna, Zurich
summary: This cable discusses information furnished by LNERGO concerning the suspected assassin of Martin Luther King, Jr., Eric Starvo Galt, and requests addressees to determine if Galt is or has been in their area.

title: Case Rundown and Incidents
summary: This memo discusses a case rundown prepared in SR/3/FI for discussions with the British in 1960 regarding an unstable American woman correspondent in Brussels who revealed anti-Soviet sympathies and later visited the subject in Moscow after being warned to avoid him.

title: Identification of James Earl Ray as Accused Assassin
recipient: DCI, DIDCI, DOP, AODD, CS/RF c/EUR, C/WH, CIFE
summary: This document identifies James Earl Ray as the accused assassin, providing his physical description, aliases, criminal record, and details of his escape from Missouri State Penitentiary.

title: Field Information Report: Guatemalan Exile Activities
summary: This document is a field information report from San Jose, Costa Rica, dated February 1, 1956, concerning Guatemalan exile activities. It includes a translated letter from Col. Carlos PAZ Tejada to Col. Francisco COSENZA Galvez, discussing a failed revolt, political relationships, and future plans.

title: Clog & Singer, Boviot Bacar Shat
summary: Report on Clog & Singer, Boviot Bacar Shat, discussing their activities and connections, including involvement in festivals and research work, as well as their political views and associations with various individuals and organizations.

title: Information Concerning Suspected Assassin of Martin Luther King, Jr.
recipient: ASUNCION, BANGKOK, BARCELONA, BEIRUT, BERLIN, BERN, BOGOTA, CARACAS, BRASILIA, BRUSSELS, BUENOS AIRES, COXNEXOONS COPENHAGEN, FRANKFURT, GENEVA, GEORGETOWN, GUATEMALA CITY, GUAYAQUIL, THE HAGUE, HAMBURG, HELSINKI, HONG KONG, KINGSTON, LA PAZ, LIMA, LONDON, MADRID, MANAGUA, MONTEVIDEOS, NEW DELHI, LISBON, MANILA, MUNICH, OSLO, PANAMA CITY PARIS PORT AU PRINCE, PORT OF SPAIN, PORTO ALEGRE, QUITO, RECIFE, RAWALPINDI, RIO DE JANERIO, ROME, SAN JOSE, SANTO DOMINGO, SAN SALVADOR, SANTIAGO, SANTIAGO DE LOS CABALLEROS, SAO PAULO, STOCKHOLM, TEGUCIGALPA, TOKYO, VIENNA, ZURICH
summary: Cable regarding information furnished by LNERGO concerning suspected assassin of Martin Luther King, Jr. - Eric Starvo Galt, alias Harvey Lowmyer, alias John Willard.

title: List of Names, Green List Numbers and 201 Numbers
summary: This document is a list of names with associated 'Green List Numbers' and '201 Numbers'. It includes names such as FERNANDEZ Coto, Milagros; MR LAS CASAS Alfonso, Crecten Leovor; MEMEZ Gonzalez, Jorge Joss; and many others. The document also notes it is a '2025 RELEASE UNDER THE PRESIDENT JOHN F. KENNEDY ASSASSINATION RECORDS ACT OF 1992' and includes a 'POA CANCELLED' notice dated '4/4/62'.

title: Transmittal of Contact Reports for First Two Meetings with AMCLOCK/1
recipient: Chief, WH/Cuba; COS, JMWAVE; Chief, DOD; Chief of Base, New York
summary: This document includes a dispatch regarding contact reports from Peter J. DI GERVENO concerning his meetings with AMCLOCK/1 in September 1967. The reports detail AMCLOCK/1's activities, observations, and intelligence production, including his views on the PBRUMEN government and security matters.

title: Contact Report/ LITAMIL-9
recipient: Chief, SAS; Chief of Base, Merida; Chief of Station, WAVE; Chief, WHD
summary: Contact reports from Mexico City regarding LITAMIL-9's interactions and information obtained in May 1963. Includes details on Cuban Embassy personnel, potential security risks, and political observations.

title: Special Activities Report on JMWAVE'S Relationship with AMCARBON-1
summary: Special Activities Report on JMWAVE's relationship with AMCARBON-1, detailing operational support tasks, intelligence furnished, and use as a propaganda outlet.

title: Report of Conditions in El Salvador
summary: Report of Conditions of the Country Inhabited by a Special Representative of the Cuban National Revolutionary Council

title: AMCUTLER-1 Progress Report for November and December 1962
summary: Progress report for AMCUTLER-1 operation in November and December 1962, detailing support for AMTAUNA, development of KUTUBE operations, potential courier channels, and information on individuals related to Cuba.

title: Debriefing of AMFAUNA-14
summary: This dispatch details the debriefing of AMFAUNA-14, a KUBARK agent, following her detention and interrogation by the DSE (Cuban State Security Department) in November-December 1963. It covers her arrest, conditions of detention, the DSE officers involved, and the information she provided, including details of her contacts, Luis Braulio VILLAR Negret and Angel BRINGAS, and her relationship with AMFAUNA-1. The dispatch also contains the station's comments and cross-references.

title: LING Lindsey, WEINER Heins Theotor
recipient: Director of Special Investigation, Inspector Genere, USAP
summary: This memo discusses Lindsey LING and Heinz Theodor WEINER. LING was contacted in Santa Maria, the Azores, by Eloy GUTIERREZ Manoyo and Rafael HERNANDEZ, both Cuban nationals. LING managed a Chinese restaurant in Madrid owned by an unidentified Chinese national who supplied clothing to US personnel. WEINER was arrested in the Azores on suspicion of espionage and was reportedly in Bermuda.

title: Information Report on Castro Agents in the US
sender: Army representative assigned to the office of preparation
summary: Report discussing Castro agents in the US attempting to determine military training camp locations and operations. Includes names of suspected individuals such as Mowerco Nunez and Angel Banos.

title: Information on William Z. Foster and French Communist Party
summary: This document is a letter from an unnamed official to J. Edgar Hoover regarding information on policy matters discussed by William Z. Foster and members of the French Communist Party in Paris. The letter summarizes actions taken by the organization on Foster's trip, including alerting stations on his itinerary and reporting on his meetings with Thorez and Duclos. The letter also mentions information from H.I.6, Section 7 regarding topics discussed at a meeting.

title: Report on Jose Xavier CORTES Hernandez
recipient: Headquarters, EMB, PAO, NA, AA, INS, LA, JIPUCK
summary: Report regarding Jose Xavier CORTES Hernandez and his interactions with the Cuban Embassy in Mexico City.

title: Cable regarding individuals Luis (Goicochea), Israel (Garcia), Carlos (Diago), Manuel (Garcia) Suarez, and Juan (Mulatt) Sanchez
summary: This cable references individuals identified as Luis (Goicochea), Israel (Garcia), Carlos (Diago), Manuel (Garcia) Suarez, and Juan (Mulatt) Sanchez. It also mentions a reference cable WAVE 6123 and discusses typic Antrunk Antrunk.

title: SIGHTING OF TANKS WITH TWIN CANNONS IN THE AREA OF HABANA
recipient: DDP, ADDP, S90 6, DODS, CA 2, CA/PEG, CA/PROP, CI/OPS, C/FIC 2, FI/INFO/I/INT 6, SAS 12, 50/1, WH 8, AD/CI 2, AD/ME/VR
summary: Report on the sighting of tanks with twin cannons in the area of Habana on 23 November 1963.

title: DIR CITE WAVE 8097 - Intelligence Operations in Cuba and Latin America
summary: This cable from JAMAVE to DIRECTON discusses various intelligence operations and requests information on individuals and activities related to Cuba and Latin America, including arms shipments, chartered flights, and personnel lists. It also provides clarifications on the identities of code names used in the message.

title: RYPAT TYPIC COMMO PETGOS AMAT HENA
summary: This cable discusses the recruitment and training of agents in a network, mentioning individuals like Oreste Tamayo, Rolando Reyes, Medara Silva, and Roberto Legon. It expresses concerns about the thoroughness of background checks and the need for comprehensive training before assigning operational tasks. It also requests more information about a contact named Rene in Victoria.

title: DIP CITE WAVE 8225
summary: This cable discusses various operations and individuals, including Teodoro, Arle, Doctor Jiveres, and others involved in KARAT ONE and TWO. It also mentions data on individuals like David, Jose Te Frana Carmona, and Esteban Suarez Rojas, along with locations and potential dangers related to revealing information. The cable references previous messages and includes WAVE comments on the operations.

title: 104-10076-10232 2025 RELEASE UNDER THE PRESIDENT JOHN F. KENNEDY ASSASSINATION RECORDS ACT OF 1992
summary: This cable discusses agent messages, potential reassignment of LUCY (ESTER ARANGO), reporting on military preparations on the north coast, and potential wiretaps.

title: 53 IN 6947S: Platypic.ayshatter - AMSTASH-1 Communication
summary: Cable details communication with AMSTASH-1 regarding exfiltration instructions, financial requests, and intelligence reports. It mentions Juan Bautista (Gonzalez) Francisco, Mexico, and possible embassy channels.

title: Exfiltration of AMFAUNA-25 from Cuba
summary: This cable discusses the potential exfiltration of AMFAUNA-25 from Cuba, in light of recent developments involving other AMFAUNA assets and the potential arrest of ANCUTLER-2. It proposes a plan to arrange a legal departure for AMFAUNA-25 under the guise of discussing Cuban insurance problems in London, involving Peter Minet of Minet Co London. The cable emphasizes the need for speed and coordination with SMOTH (likely a code name for an organization or individual) to ensure the success of the operation.

title: ITHWAVE 2395 OTIC ATHENA PETSOS COMMO
summary: This document contains translated messages regarding potential recruits and intelligence gathering in Cuba, including biographical data, recommendations for action agents, and details about sabotage objectives and target locations.

title: Classified Message Regarding Agent ASG and Related Operations
summary: This cable discusses an agent ASG's message regarding the retrieval of a pouch, the potential exfiltration of 'IMINA SILIO', and a pick-up from 'MANOLO (DIEGO)' in Mexico. It also includes information for the Director only, identifying individuals like EMILIO as EXILIO CARBO, TONY as ARCANOE-3, JUDE as ARRIPE-2, and MANOLO (DIEGO) as a relative of ASGIPE-1.

title: MADR (RFG DIR MEXI CITE WAVE 8525
recipient: DOP, CI, CI/OPS, CI/OA, FI, SAS, VR
summary: This document is a cable concerning individuals ODON (ALVAREZ) DE LA CAMPA, GILBERTO (LIWAY) RODRIGUEZ, (ALDO (VERA) SERAFIN), and (MANOLO (UZIEL).

title: Cable regarding shipment of envelopes to Copal Caples, Florida
summary: This document discusses the shipment of envelopes to a specific address in Copal Caples, Florida, and mentions difficulties in sending them through a classified pouch until December 13.

classification: John F. Kennedy Assassination Records Act
summary: This document discusses individuals PERGREN AMSTONE, THEMISTOCLES APOSPOROS, and GARCIA ROSELL. It includes references to DDP, CI, CI/CA, SAS 8, VR, and mentions a communication on 7 DEC 63 IN 75579, and DIA CITE WAVE 8542.

title: DIR CITE WAVE 8724
summary: This cable discusses the transfer of items through Enrique (Vicente Socorras) and the Japanese Embassy. It mentions the receipt of Magnum pistols without bullets and radios, requesting information on the radios' range and the filters for the pistols. It references RYBAT, ANTURVY, SAGTEL, WAVE 8724, WAVE 8694, and ANTURVY-1.

title: WAVE 8740: Agent Communication and Russian Ship Information
summary: This cable discusses planned communications with an agent, including sending supplies and money, and requests information on a Russian ship arriving in Havana.

title: DIR CITE WAVE 8883
recipient: INFO DOP, ADDP, RI/AN DUMMY, D/OC 2, VR
summary: This document is a SECRET cable discussing individuals and operations related to Cuba, including names like OTTO, AQUILES, Doctor Jimenes (AURELIO MARTINEZ), JOSE CAMPOS PEREZ, and AGUILA. It mentions activities on LIBERTAD 12 and CAYO LEVISA, along with concerns about security and communication. The cable also refers to previous communications (WAVE 8699, WAVE 8780) and mentions NAV comments on individuals related to ANCLATTER-5 and KMARTINEZ.

title: BOUTING
summary: Cable discusses the sequestration of information regarding Carlos (Evans) Roman and Mariano Virgilio de la Caridad (Ramirez) Alarcon.

title: Travel of Soviets from Batabano to Isla de Pinos, Cargo Traffic Between Isla de Pinos and Batabano
recipient: DOP, OOP, SOD 6, CA 2, CA/PEG, CA/PROP, CI/OPS, FI, FI/D, FI/INTI, SR 7, WH 7, DD/1, AD/CI 2, AD/NE, AD/RR 36/NR/
summary: This telegram discusses the travel of Soviets from Batabano to Isla de Pinos, as well as cargo traffic between the two locations. It details specific instances of trucks and ferries being used to transport personnel and goods.

title: TRUCK TRAFFIC AND TUBE-LIKE OBJECTS SEEN ENTERING TORRENS BASE
summary: Cable discusses truck traffic and tube-like objects seen entering Torrens base in Cuba between October 9 and November 7, 1963. Source reports trucks covered with canvas traveling towards Torrens, the former reformatory on the Wajay Highway southwest of Habana. Tube-like objects protruding from trucks observed on October 11.

title: ZAVE 9926 RYSST TYPIC YOBITE AMWORLD
summary: Cable discusses individuals and operations related to ANYUM in Cuba, including potential cut-outs for intelligence operations. summary: This cable requests training for Marta (Valdes) Iernandez, an employee of the Ministry of Health and Welfare in Havana, who recently completed studies in Mexico under the World Health Organization. No traces were found in Mexico.

The asset is considered a highly qualified engineer and could provide valuable information. The cable also mentions the need for secure communication channels and cautions against using the asset for contact with individuals trusted by Guevara but not by the agency.

title: LIENVOY-8
summary: This dispatch concerns LIENVOY-8, a source who caused a security problem in 1960. Headquarters requests an update on his current status and reliability, including whether he has been terminated or is still being used.

title: FEQ Part I - Alfonso Dibtido Torres
summary: This dispatch concerns Alfonso Dibtido Torres and requests Provisional Operational Approval along with a 201 number. It also mentions that the Subject's cryptonym, assigned 15 October 1965 by the Station, follows under separate cover.

title: MEXI 7416
summary: This cable discusses a request from [S/] for 190 dollars in view of his wife's visit to Mexico City for Christmas. It also mentions [S/]'s living situation, his connection to a PCM member named Eliodorina Garcia, and upcoming meetings.

summary: This document contains information regarding Soviet technicians in Cuba, Cuban military activities, and the general attitude towards the Soviet presence.

summary: This cable discusses the conclusion of a review of the ZRPRIMA program, which aimed to recruit Cuban technicians. The review found the program unsuccessful due to various factors, including the Cuban government's lack of enthusiasm and bureaucratic issues. The cable advises stations to discontinue intensive searches for ZRPRIMA candidates but remain alert for opportunities to place agents in Cuba.

It details SZULC's past pro-communist activities, his relationship with SACHS, and his efforts to gain employment in American press circles. summary: This memo discusses the potential damage to CIA Miami from the prosecution of the Rolando Masferrer Haitian invasion group. It highlights risks from publicity, potential actions by the University of Miami, and the possibility of the defense involving CIA Miami in the case.

summary: This dispatch from the Chief of Station, JMWAVE, concerns IDEN A (Alfred J. Moran), a wealthy New Orleans businessman used by JMWAVE for cover operations and funding. It details his involvement with YOCOUGH, other JMWAVE assets, and requests a 201 number be assigned to him.

summary: MI-5 has provided information on Jim Garrison's activities to the FBI via a report on Americans in correspondence with the Bertrand Russell Peace Foundation. The foundation appears to be trying to persuade Garrison to write an article about the Kennedy assassination.

The document also clarifies that General Hardin is not synonymous with Philip Harbin.

summary: This document discusses a request from Australian Justice A.R. Moffitt for information on Herbert Itkin, whom he described as a former CIA and FBI employee, in relation to an inquiry into organized crime. The CIA's Office of General Counsel (OGC) provided Moffitt with copies of three affidavits relevant to Itkin's affiliation with the CIA, stating that Itkin furnished information to the CIA over many years but did not collect information for them in England.

summary: Request for approval or investigative action related to Santiago ALVAREZ Fernandes and project PM Trainees in Cuba. Mentions security checks and list statuses.

title: CI Suspect: Irving AMRON
summary: This memorandum details an interview with Irving Amron, a potential candidate for a Russian language linguist position. The interview covers Amron's background, including his family history, time spent in the USSR, education, and employment history. The interviewer expresses concerns about Amron's candor and possible connections to the KGB.

title: MEMORANDUM OF CONTACT: Jose Antonio CASAS Rodriguez
summary: This memorandum details a contact with Jose Antonio CASAS Rodriguez regarding his knowledge of the Cuban situation and personalities, potential recruitment of Cuban officials, and operational proposals.

Barker, and Manolo VEGA Abril, who have worked with or are of interest to the agency. It details their backgrounds, skills, and potential value to the agency's operations, particularly in Latin America and Cuba.

title: Former Contacte Vivana Itakon
summary: The document discusses several individuals, including Adolfo SAN FELAYO, Ramon USATEGUI Lazara, Herbert L. Barker, and Manolo VEGA Abril, assessing their value as potential agents or contacts for the CIA. It also mentions their backgrounds, skills, and loyalty.

title: Mollie BLOCK; Morris BLOCK
summary: This memo details information received from the Dutch Internal Security Service (BVD) regarding Mollie BLOCK and Morris BLOCK's travel and intentions to settle in Moscow.

title: FBI Documents on MIRR and Cuban Exile Activities
summary: Documents related to MIRR, Cuban exiles, and Orlando Bosch Avila, including bombing activities and investigations.

title: DOCUMENT TRANSFER AND CROSS REFERENCE - CROWDER, EDWARD/JR.
summary: Document transfer and cross reference for Edward Crowder Jr., indicating derogatory information held by the Panamanian Dept of National Investigations.

title: CONTACT REPORT
sender: C. FRANK STONE ITI, Chief DO/CORO
summary: This contact report details a conversation with WUBRINY/1 regarding various operations including a tire recap plant in Greece, difficulties with WUBRINY/4, pumice operations in Martinique, and an encounter with M. Charles and George de Mohrenschildt who discussed the situation in Haiti.

title: Report on Robin Moore and Blue Hole as a Potential Base of Operations
summary: Report on Robin Moore and Blue Hole as a potential base of operations for activities related to Cuba, including personnel landing. Discusses Moore's background, site evaluation, and operational considerations. Mentions potential resources and contacts in Jamaica.

title: CHAYES, ABRAM DCS FILE
sender: Ruth Elliff, Acting Chief, USSR-EE Collection Group
summary: This file contains documents related to Abram Chayes, including memoranda, lists of attendees at the Pugwash Conference in Munich, Germany in August 1977, and process sheets for DCD collections.

title: Security Checks and Information on Rogelio Wenceslav Cisneros Diaz
sender: Chief, MIAMI FIELD OFFICE; Office of Security
summary: This document contains various memoranda and reports related to security checks and information on Rogelio Wenceslav Cisneros Diaz, including travel history, residences, employment, and affiliations.

title: Immediate SDOM INFO IMMEDIATE DIR SNDRCITE WAVE 5413
summary: This document discusses the procurement of a DC-3 type aircraft for a group of stranded newsmen, code-named AMCORE-2, in SDOM (Santo Domingo). It outlines the plan to arrange a charter through KUBARK proprietary and potentially involve Mackey Airlines. The document also mentions providing cover stories and financial arrangements for the charter.

title: INTEL/TYPIC - AMCORE 2 Production
summary: Dispatch regarding AMCORE-2 production and deployment sketch of battalion defensive positions obtained from Agent 1995.

title: Letters Received by AMCORE-2
summary: This dispatch from February 21, 1963, discusses the potential for establishing contact with AMCORE-2's source to enhance the usefulness of diverted items and possibly eliminate AMCORE-2's role. It requests JIGAVE to identify AMCORE-2's source and explore contact methods.

summary: These documents relate to the operational status and biographical data of Thomas E. Davis, including security checks, employment history, neighborhood investigation, and requests for operational clearance. The documents indicate interest in Davis for mapping work and operational use, with checks conducted by various agencies, including the FBI. Also included are biographical notes of James S. Ovens, the Director, Ohio State University Research Foundation, for operational clearance.

title: SAUREL, Jean K.
summary: This memo discusses Jean K. Saurel and his alleged connections to the Ton Ton Macoutes and President Duvalier, as well as his acquaintance with George and Jeane De Mohrenschildt. It also requests that the information not be disseminated further without prior approval from the CIA.

title: Conversations with REICHHARDT, 8, 9, 16, 17 September 1959
summary: Memorandum detailing conversations with REICHHARDT concerning various intelligence matters related to Cuba, including immigration status, potential double agents, and Cuban Air Force activities.

title: Report of Contact with DCHAR on 13 August 1957
summary: Report of Contact with DCHAR on 13 August 1957, discussing fund-raising efforts, potential contacts with Julio Lobo, establishment of a propaganda program, and information on Soviet presence and Communist activities within the Cuban armed forces.

recipient: Chief, Western Haishore Division; Chief, Special Affairs Staff; Chief of Station, JMAVE AKR
summary: This dispatch discusses the operational developments of Identity, a JHPALM asset, including training sessions, contacts, and intelligence reports provided. It also covers future plans for Identity and mentions several individuals and locations.

title: Operational Delivery of Material to Subjects
summary: Dispatch from COS, San Salvador, requesting delivery of materials to subjects in reference to operational matters.

summary: Antonio Varona of the Cuban Revolutionary Council seeks support from President Chiari of Panama to overthrow the Castro regime, but Panama denies the request to establish a training base for Cuban exiles.

title: Transmittal of Memorandum of Oral Commitment for Alberto PONZOA y Alvarez
summary: Transmittal of Memorandum of Oral Commitment for Alberto PONZOA y Alvarez. Subject was a contact of the Havana Station and made sea rendezvous operations. He now wishes to disassociate himself completely from any Cuban political group and desires to place himself under KUBARK control. It is proposed to use Subject as a small boat captain in maritime operations.

title: Report on Anti-Castro Activities in Cuba
recipient: Chief, Tack Force/W; Chief of Station, JAVE
summary: This document discusses Alberto Mariano Parojon Cerconas's involvement with anti-Castro groups EAC, FAL, and Vortice Tres in Cuba during 1962. It includes details about the organizations' activities, contacts, and needs.

title: Pseudonym/Cryptonym Assignment Form
summary: This document appears to be a form related to the assignment of pseudonyms and cryptonyms for individuals or projects. It includes details such as aliases assigned, project descriptions (ALLADIE), status of personnel (staff employees), and mentions individuals like N. Parrisson. It also references previous pseudonyms or cryptonyms assigned (SEAR) and contains instructions for handling and distribution of the document within the CIA.

title: Handling of a Soviet Defector
summary: This document discusses the handling of a Soviet defector, ABLADLE, including challenges, retrospective analysis, findings, and areas of study for Headquarters. It covers the defector's evacuation, the unique factors of the case, and recommendations for improving future operations.

title: Plans to Establish Secure Communication Between WAVE and A-3 Groups
summary: This message discusses plans to establish secure communication between WAVE and A-3 groups, including dispatching AMJAVA-4 by BLACK for infiltration into Cuba.

title: MAVANA Cable on Airdrop Map and Arms Request
summary: Cable regarding airdrop map to Miami for 'Clarence' and requests for arms and ammunition.

title: PAITY DIR INFO PRITY MASH CITEHAVA 6905
summary: This cable discusses a drop of weapons to anti-Castro forces in Cuba. It mentions that some of the weapons were recovered by the GOC (Government of Cuba), while the remainder is believed to be in the hands of anti-Castro forces. The cable also references successful drops to Evelio Duque forces by AKHAWK using a Cessna aircraft.

title: File Content List of File No. 201-0191098
summary: This document is a file content list for file number 201-0191098, which pertains to Susan Heiligman Frank. The list includes various documents, their dates, symbols and numbers, types, and subjects related to Richard Cyril Frank, Yung Koon-Man, Ivan Gerald Shapiro, Frederick Vanderbilt Field, and others. The list also includes references to internal security matters and China.

title: Letter regarding financial aid for families of political prisoners
summary: This letter discusses the financial situation and needs of individuals and families associated with political prisoners in Cuba. It details the distribution of funds, difficulties in obtaining food, and other challenges faced by those affected.

title: SJAN 0835: Potential Channel Between Artecona and PBRUMEN
summary: Cable discusses a potential channel between JOSE ARTECONA and PBRUMEN through IDEN B using a "diplomatic pouch" for messages and small arms. IDEN A suggests ARTECONA present his request to his KUBARK contact in Miami.

title: SJAN 0836 WAVE INFO DIR HAGU
summary: This cable discusses Collin E. Ostrander, a USIA representative in San Juan, and Waldemar F. Lee, the Netherlands Consul in San Juan, referencing previous communication SJAN BS35.

title: AMSPELL Progress Report for September 1962
summary: This document is an AMSPELL progress report for September 1962, detailing AMHINT and AMDARB activities. It includes information on intelligence production, support for AMSPELL, and diplomatic pouches intercepted by AMBLEAK-1, revealing operational planning.

title: DOMINICAN CACHING OPERATIONS
summary: This document discusses Dominican support of Cuban exiles.

title: TYPIC/ANSPELL/Operational AMSPELL Tour of Latin America
summary: This dispatch discusses the AMSPELL exhibit tour of Latin America from February to June 1964. The tour aimed to showcase the dangers and weaknesses of Castro-Communism. While the exhibit achieved excellent results in Guayaquil and La Paz, it was only moderately successful overall, failing in Quito, Santiago, and Montevideo. The dispatch evaluates the tour's effectiveness, highlighting organizational difficulties and the team's inexperience. It includes details on publicity, attendance, and challenges faced in various cities.

title: Plans and Activities of the Directorio Revolucionario
summary: This report details the plans and activities of the Directorio Revolucionario, a Cuban student organization, including their efforts to plan an uprising against the government and their contacts with various factions.

title: Classified Message Regarding DIVOUR/AMBARH
summary: This is a classified message regarding DIVOUR/AMBARH and related individuals such as LUIS FERNANDEZ ROCHA SODRIGUEZ, HANUEL SALVAT-COQUE, FELIX GUILLERMO OTHON PACHO, and FERNANDO GARCIA-CHALON CHACON.

title: Cables Regarding Carlos Prio Socarras' Financial Activities and Cuban Political Involvement
summary: These cables discuss Carlos Prio Socarras' financial activities and potential involvement in Cuban political matters, including suspicions of funding revolutionary activities and currency exchanges.

title: AMSPELL Progress Reports and Related Dispatches
summary: These documents detail the activities, funding, and future plans of AMSPELL, an organization involved in propaganda and political action related to Cuba and Latin America. Key activities include disseminating printed and radio propaganda, corresponding with student groups, and campaigning for the release of political prisoners.

title: Alpha 66 Doings in Los Angeles as of September 1970
document_type: Routing and Record Sheet, Notices, Propaganda, Interview, Article
origin_agency: Los Angeles Office, Domestic Contact Service
sender: Chief, Los Angeles Office, Operational Support Staff
summary: This document contains information on Alpha 66 activities in Los Angeles as of September 1970, including notices of meetings, propaganda, a history of Alpha 66, a picture of Vicente Mendez, a tape of a meeting/interview with Los Angeles leader Miguel Talleda, and a press interview with Andreas Nazario Sargent, Alpha 66 Secretary General in the US. It also includes articles and propaganda related to Alpha 66 activities and their impact on Cuba.

title: Ramparts: John Garrett UNDERHILL Jr., Samuel George CUMMINGS, and INTERARMCO
summary: This memorandum discusses Ramparts magazine's claims about John Garrett Underhill Jr., Samuel George Cummings, and Interarmco's alleged involvement in a CIA gun-running, narcotics, and political intrigue racket related to the Kennedy assassination. It includes information about Underhill's background, his reported concerns about a CIA clique, and the circumstances surrounding his death. The memo also provides details about Cummings' history with the CIA, his role with Interarmco, and his contacts with other intelligence agencies. The document also mentions that these individuals and Interarmco have not been prominently featured in the Garrison investigation.

title: Garrison Investigation: Emilio SANTANA Galindo
summary: This memorandum discusses the Garrison Investigation of Emilio Santana Galindo, who was recruited by the Agency in October 1962 and participated in an infiltration operation in May 1963. The memo lists staff and agent personnel who had contact with Galindo.

title: Operatlona 'GYROSE/KUDESK/KUWOLF7PÅ G-2 Penetration Action Against AMSPELL Organization and Other Groups in PBRUMEN
summary: This dispatch from Chief, Task Force W to Chief of Station, JMWAVE, discusses G-2 penetration action against the AMSPELL organization and other groups in PBRUMEN. It details meetings, plans, and individuals involved in the operation, including Jorge MEDINA Bringuier, AEDO, and AMHINT-33. The dispatch also mentions concerns about G-2 infiltration and potential contacts with anti-Castro groups.

title: Operational-Transmittal of CA Reports
summary: This dispatch contains CA reports (numbers 134 through 149, and 156) and an index. The reports relate to various individuals, including Jose Antonio Sacens, and cover topics such as DRE activities in Santiago, Cuba, potential military installations, and foreign instructors at the University of Oriente.

title: Activity of Directorio Revolucionario Estudiantil (DRE) and Cuban Military Observations
summary: This document details the activities of the Directorio Revolucionario Estudiantil (DRE), a student resistance organization in Habana, including its leadership, propaganda efforts, and fundraising activities. It also mentions bombings at the University of Habana and the fortification of the Alturas del Bosque area by the Cuban government. Additionally, it discusses the limited number of Cuban air force jets observed in the air.

title: JMZIP/KUTUBE/KUDES/KUSODA DRS Internal Codes/Sources and Companion
summary: This dispatch contains information about JMZIP/KUTUBE/KUDES/KUSODA, DRS Internal Codes/Sources and Companions. It includes details on DRE representatives, their aliases, dates of birth, and activities in Cuba, as well as information on G-2 agents and militia battalions in Caibarien, Las Villas. The document also provides details on communication codes, frequencies, and code names to be used by the DRE, along with locations for delivering arms and equipment.

title: Herrrutibeascon
summary: Dispatch regarding Herrrutibeascon, a young Cuban named Land who talked to Identity 1, and Jose Maria Lasa rutibeasoon's meeting with Identity 1 and Identity 2. Subject wanted to get his father into this country with assurance of support.

title: Activities of the DRE (Directorio Revolucionario Estudiantil)
recipient: Chief of Station, JMWAVE; Chief, Task Force W
summary: This memo discusses the activities of the Directorio Revolucionario Estudiantil (DRE) in Cuba, including information about arms shipments and planned sabotage activities against the Castro regime.

title: CITCUBA
summary: Report on Juan Rodriguez Jobolca's interview, detailing his involvement with the DRF and DRE, and information about Salvador Jomolca, a guerrilla leader in Las Villas Province.

title: Operational/GYROSE, KUCAGE/AMHINT. Debriefing of PBRUMEN Legal Travelers for PW Aspects
summary: This dispatch discusses the debriefing of PBRUMEN Legal Travelers for PW Aspects. It covers topics such as reception of radio programs in Cuba, opinions on anti-Castro propaganda, and internal organization of the DRE.

title: GYROSE/Operational-Transmittal of CAC Reports and Related Intelligence
summary: This document includes a dispatch from Chief, Task Force W to Chief of Station, JMWAVE, regarding the transmittal of fourteen CIA reports and an index. The attachment includes an index of CIA reports with subjects ranging from the Office of the Secretary of the Presidency to lists of Cubans entering the U.S. with false visas. Another attachment details an interview with Ignacio Pla Martinez, a member of the DRE and FUAC, regarding anti-communist activities. A third document refers to the liquidation of the resistance in Sagua la Grande.

title: WEB/PBRUEN - Resistance Activity in Cuba
recipient: Acting Chief, WE; Chief of Station, Madrid
summary: This dispatch details information provided by Francisco Luis Rodrigues Gonzales, a Cuban refugee, regarding resistance activity in Cuba. It includes details about the Revolutionary Student Directorate, sabotage activities, and a planned insurrection in the Sierra Maestra area. It also mentions the capture and imprisonment of group members, including two Americans from Guantanamo Naval Base.

title: MEXI 7200: PO Box Acquisition for Cuban Agents
summary: This cable discusses obtaining post office boxes in Mexico City for use by agents being dispatched to Cuba. It includes a specific PO Box address and mentions the effort to acquire additional boxes.

title: MEXI 7184
summary: This cable lists three addresses in Mexico City: Armando B. Sanchez, Berta A. Martinez, and Antonio Busto. These addresses are requested by HQS as accommodation addresses in the MEXI area for use by S/ agents.

title: Accommodation Addresses Needed in Mexico for Agents Dispatched to Cuba
summary: This cable discusses accommodation addresses in the Mexico area needed for use by S/M agents being dispatched to Cuba before February 1st. It mentions Faurelio A. Martinez and provides an address in Mexico City.

title: MEXI 6502: Problem of Roberto de Varona and AMHAWK's involvement in Cuban exile training.
summary: This cable discusses the problem of Roberto de Varona, who is independently recruiting and training Cubans for a planned invasion of Cuba, possibly in November or December. AMHAWK is said to be involved. The station is considering having a Gobernacion agent advise Roberto to leave the country.

title: Suspicious Concerning Possible Crotrioto Mission in US for Salvador Rodriguez Santena
summary: Report regarding a suspicious Crotioto Mission in the US for Salvador Rodriguez Santena, involving the International Rescue Committee and Charles Sternberg.

title: Dispatches on Frits (aka Fred) SNSCI, Refugee Programs, and Operational Matters
summary: This document contains dispatches regarding Frits (aka Fred) SNSCI, his background, activities, and potential connections to the 'Rota Kapello' network. It also includes information on various international organizations assisting stateless refugees and reports passed to Brazilian authorities concerning Russian immigrants.

title: Conversation between President Lopez Mateos of Mexico and Mr. Winston Scott, Chief of Station, Mexico
sender: J. C. King, Chief, Western Hemisphere Division
summary: This memorandum discusses a conversation between President Lopez Mateos of Mexico and Mr. Winston Scott, Chief of Station, Mexico, regarding President Lopez Mateos's relationship with the United States and his stance on inviting Fidel Castro to Mexico. It also mentions CIA intentions to overthrow Castro and suggests informing President Eisenhower of Lopez Mateos's views.

title: Gold Shipments Report
summary: This document reports on gold smuggling activities involving a B-26 airplane and its crew in Panama during May-July 1950. It details the plane's movements, the individuals involved, and the suspicions surrounding the cargo. The report also mentions the dismissal of the head of Tocumen Airport and the potential involvement of President ARIAS's nephew.

title: Cuban Economic Crisis
summary: This document details the Cuban economic crisis in August 1959, citing concerns over agrarian reforms, government subsidies, and potential financial reliance on the Soviet Union. It includes information sourced from a Cuban government official and another source connected to the Banco Industrial de Cuba.

title: INFILTRATION VIA GHA JEAN III
summary: This cable discusses the infiltration of several individuals via GHA JEAN III, including ALCO VERA SERAFIT, BRAIDIO CONTRERA, ANGEL POSADA GUTIERREZ, RINALDO HERNANDEZ BLANCO, RAFAEL GARCIA AUDIO, EZNIGNO PEREZ, PEDRO SERCIO CUELLAR ALONSO, and JOSE FERNANDEZ SADUE. It requests approval to run OPN JEAN 111.

title: Cable regarding TEJANA departure for Operation JEAN
summary: This cable details the planned departure of TEJANA from Key West on February 25th, 1961, for Operation JEAN, carrying cargo and four trainees: Emilio Martinez alias Ernesto Guerra Vidal, Oliverio Toneu alias Antonio Del Monte Caballero, Rafael Alvarez Fernandez-Garrido alias Maximo Alonso Bermudez, and Carlos Poveda alias Calixto Bergnes Braudet.

title: GUITART CAIPIZANO, AGUSTINN, DR.
sender: CHIEF, CI/OPERATIONAL APPROVAL AND SUPPORT DIVISION; Deputy Director of Security
recipient: Chief, SAS/OS; Deputy Director of Security
summary: These documents pertain to the operational approval and investigation of Agustin Guitart Campuzano, including requests for information, name checks, and coordination with other agencies like the FBI.

title: HSCA 44.40 VOL II; DERIN Maurice Hyman; American Communists in Mexico and Their Contacts; Noah SEBORER and Family
summary: This file contains information on James A. PERRY, Maurice Hyman HALPERIN, American Communists in Mexico, and Noah SEBORER. It includes details about their activities, contacts, and investigations.

title: HALPERIN, MAURICE HYMAN
summary: This file contains material reviewed at CIA Headquarters by House Select Committee on Assassinations staff members regarding Maurice Hyman Halperin. It includes FBI and State Department reports and telegrams, as well as a document transfer and cross-reference sheet, a routing and record sheet, and a dispatch from the Chief of Station, Mexico City concerning a booklet written by Halperin.

title: HALPERIN MAURICE HYMAN
summary: This document is a collection of documents related to Maurice Hyman Halperin. It includes FBI files, outgoing messages from the CIA, newspaper articles, and an alumni magazine article. The documents cover the period from 1962 to 1976 and discuss Halperin's alleged involvement with Soviet espionage, his work for the Soviet government, and his academic career.

title: 104-10172-10133 2025 RELEASE UNDER THE PRESIDENT JOHN F. KENNEDY ASSASSINATION RECORDS ACT OF 1992
summary: Cable discusses a RADOP candidate provided by AMDENIM-1 for infiltration into PBRUMEN, replacing a subject who failed a communication assessment test. It also requests a POA on BENICIA (GONZALEZ) GOMEZ.

title: Request for Priority POAs on Cuban Nationals
summary: This cable requests priority POAs (Proof of Address) on EDDA (HERNANDEZ) GONZALEZ, BENICIA (GONZALEZ) GOMEZ and CADELAIDA (MARTINEZ) ANDREADES.

title: GYROSE/Operational AMDENIM-1 Progress Report - 13 August 1962
summary: This dispatch details the progress of AMDENIM-1, focusing on maintaining exile group relations, intelligence gathering on the PRPUNEN community, and attempts to establish contact with PBRUMEN fishermen through Operation Antonico I.

title: DIR INFO WAVE CITE BARR 0134 JMZIP KUSODA KUDESK
summary: Cable discusses Antonio Cuesta, an associate of Mrs. Geddes, who is a former crewmember of the Tejana III and a friend of AMDENIM-1. Cuesta is making inquiries about a boat and may return to PBRUMEN soon. The cable also mentions George Hopping as a reliable source of information.

title: AELADLE
summary: This document discusses AELADLE and AESTORAGE, intelligence operations related to Soviet activities in Helsinki and Moscow. It details information from a source who interacted with the KGB and was later deemed unlikely to be assigned to the US due to potential identification by a defector.

title: Bonn 4798: Information Exchange Regarding AELADLE
summary: This cable discusses the appropriate handling of information exchange between German services regarding AELADLE, suggesting direct communication between UPHILL and CAVATA/ASBV instead of KUBARK acting as a middleman to avoid affecting German security.

title: REDCAP LUIMPROVE AELADLE
summary: This dispatch discusses a meeting with WEYDE where AELADLE mentioned a KGB officer in Germany who shares his political views and should be left alone by Western intelligence. WEYDE believes the officer's name may be AKHLUYEV, but is not certain. The dispatch suggests querying AELADLE further to confirm the officer's identity.

title: OUTGOING MESSAGE - Checking with Noshenko and Wallenberg Investigation
summary: This cable discusses checking with Noshenko regarding PD DIPPERS 19 and 20 and PDLADLE re Wallenberg. It also mentions file 201-5935, E2 IMPDET.A.

title: REDCOAT/LCIMPROVE/AELADLE Tabe Maria Ingeborg SLIOOR (201-765030)
summary: This dispatch concerns Tabe Maria Ingeborg SLIOOR (201-765030) and her immigrant visa application. She was interviewed and granted a visa after being questioned about Soviet contacts. The dispatch includes VALIK traces, a copy of her visa, birth record, and marriage certificate.

title: Clarification of Information on Soviet Personnel in Finland
summary: This dispatch clarifies information regarding Soviet personnel in Finland, specifically Mikhail Vasilyevich KURIACHEV, Petr Nikitovich SAVALVEY, Ivan Yefimovich SERGEYEV, and their replacements. It discusses their roles, contacts, and potential involvement in intelligence activities.

title: Valentin Sergeyevich Loginov Personnel File
summary: Report on Valentin Sergeyevich Loginov, a Soviet Attache stationed in Havana. The report details his background, personality, activities, and potential vulnerabilities.

title: Valentin Sergeyevich Loginov and Soviet Embassy Activities in Mexico City
summary: These documents discuss Valentin Sergeyevich Loginov, a suspect KGB officer in Mexico City, his activities, contacts, and family. They also mention an unidentified visitor to the Soviet Embassy and John Stratos, who sought a ticket to the Soviet Union.

title: E. Howard Hunt Investigation Records
summary: These documents consist of memoranda and routing sheets regarding the investigation into E. Howard Hunt's activities, particularly his assignment to Madrid in the mid-1960s and financial transactions. The search for any undocumented payments to Hunt, especially around $30,000, is detailed, along with recollections from various Agency personnel about Hunt's role and activities. The documents also explore Hunt's post-Agency employment, his contacts with the Robert R. Mullen public relations firm, and requests he made for personnel with specific skills.

title: E. Howard Hunt Investigation
sender: Director of Finance; S. D. Breckinridge; Robert E. Owen
summary: These documents relate to the CIA's investigation into E. Howard Hunt's activities, particularly his assignment to Madrid in the mid-1960s and any potential financial irregularities. The documents include internal memos, interview summaries, and record searches related to Hunt's operational activities, travel expenses, and bank accounts.

title: ISAACS, HAROLD
summary: This file contains documents related to Harold Isaacs, including memos, letters, and articles, detailing his activities and associations, particularly concerning his political views and alleged Trotskyist connections. The documents also cover the history and suspension of the China Forum, a publication Isaacs founded and edited.

title: Collection of Intelligence Reports on Cuba
summary: This document appears to be a collection of intelligence reports, possibly related to the Cuban Missile Crisis or other Cold War activities. It includes various memos, dispatches, and cables, likely containing information about Soviet activities in Cuba, US responses, and related political and military strategies. The reports contain sensitive information about personnel, operations, and security matters.

title: Summary of Cuban Media Treatment of the Death of Martin Luther King, Jr.

sender: Evalena S. Vidal, Political Action Division and Henry Lopez (Edvard G. Tichborn)

title: Payment to Rivard G. Tichborn (P)
summary: This memorandum details the payment process for Rivard G. Tichborn's salary after his Cuban trip. It outlines the clearance of a $650.00 check drawn on Ashmead, Haniford Associates and its planned forwarding to Tichborn's California bank.

title: Meeting with Henry P. Lopes at Carleton Hotel
summary: This memorandum details a meeting with Henry P. Lopes regarding operations in Cuba, including briefing him on the situation, providing funds, and instructions for contacting Benjamin Avana. It also covers security precautions and accounting procedures.

title: Meeting with Henry P. Lopez at the Statler-Hilton Hotel on 1 February 1960
summary: Memorandum regarding a meeting with Henry P. Lopez concerning his contacts in Cuba and recommendations for influencing Castro.

title: Debriefing of Edward G. Tichbern(P)
summary: Debriefing of Edward G. Tichborn regarding his trip to Cuba. Discussion includes the political climate in Cuba, Fidel Castro's reactions to defections, the schism between Fidel and Raoul Castro, and potential contacts who might influence Fidel Castro. Mentions potential propaganda opportunities and a security matter regarding a possible State Department agent.

title: Edward G. Tichborn's Bank Account Details and Payment Instructions
summary: This memo details Edward G. Tichborn's bank account at Bank of America, Wilshire-Sweetzer Branch, Los Angeles. It includes instructions for depositing operational advances and salary payments into his Commercial Account. The memo mentions a $2,000 operational advance check mailed from Washington on January 15, 1960, and a $650 salary check to be mailed to the same bank.

title: Clarification of Mission Procedures in Cuba
summary: This memo outlines instructions and procedures for Mr. Tichborn's mission in Cuba. It details briefings, contact protocols, cover stories, and administrative tasks.

title: HEXORAMAH FOR: Chief, Cover Division SUBJECT: (Henry P. Lopes)
sender: Horace W. Davis, Acting Chief, Political Action Division
summary: This memo discusses providing backstopping facilities for Henry P. Lopes by Mchawad, Zarifort Associates. It outlines procedures for expense reporting and provides Lopes' address.

title: LYNCH, GRAYSON
summary: This file contains memoranda regarding Grayston Lynch, a retired CIA employee, and his involvement with LNCOLLAR, a drug enforcement agency. It details his recruitment, activities, and subsequent issues with the agency.

title: Operational Activities and Assessment of Alfonso R. Wichtrich (HYDROL) in Panama and Mexico

recipient: Chief, WIDE; Chief, Foreign Branch T
summary: This collection of documents pertains to Alfonso R. Wichtrich, also known as HYDROL, and his involvement in intelligence operations in Panama and Mexico. The documents detail his recruitment, activities, capabilities, and suitability for various covert operations, as well as his contacts and networks. The documents also cover project reviews, financial authorizations, and recommendations regarding his continued engagement.

title: IN 55255: RETTIE, LICOOKY-1, and Contacts
summary: Cable discusses contact between British newsman RETTIE and LICOOKY-1, as well as RETTIE's attempts to contact Mario Fonteforte Toledo. It also mentions LICOOKY-1's relationship with AREVALO.

title: Response to Memo on "Council for Latin America"
summary: This memo from March 29, 1967, details WI/I's activities related to the Council for Latin America, specifically addressing involvement with four organizations: Confederación Mexicana de Cámaras Industriales, Instituto de Investigaciones Sociales y Económicas, Centro Nacional de Estudios Sociales, and American Chamber of Commerce of Mexico. It outlines funding, objectives, and personnel associated with these organizations, including agent activities and project statuses.

title: Lyle STUART
summary: This memorandum discusses Lyle Stuart's dealings with Juan Jose Arevalo, Dr. Raul Osegueda, Bartolome Costa Amic, and Mario Monteforte Toledo, focusing on book publications, royalty payments, and potential contacts. It also mentions Eileen Brant and Angela Delli Sante-Arroche as potential sources of information.

title: LIHUFF/1
summary: This dispatch pertains to LIHUFF/1, an outside agent recruited as a cutout for the LIHUFF/2 organization. The dispatch includes personal history statements and requests processing a contract for the subject.

title: Derwin Ferguson UTTERELL, William Hamilton MARTIN, Espionage - RR
summary: This memorandum discusses George PERISTEROPOULOS aka PERIS, his contacts, and his potential connections to Soviet intelligence operations. It also explores his relationship with William Hamilton MARTIN and Valentine HAHN, and their possible involvement with a Tokyo nightclub.

title: ZRGRACE - Tokyo Aspect; George PERIS aka George PERISTEROPOULOS aka George PARIS, Identified Contact of Valentin HAHN aka Valentine Vasiliyevich KHAN aka Won-shin HAN, Self Confessed Soviet Agent
summary: This memo discusses George PERIS, a contact of Valentin HAHN, who is suspected of being a Soviet agent. It details HAHN's debriefing, his contacts, and the possibility of PERIS's involvement in espionage activities and connections to individuals of interest in previous investigations.

title: DIR CITE MEXI 2126
summary: This cable discusses Joaquin Mirabal, his background, connections, and activities. It also mentions Mrs. Albert Recio and NENICA GARCIA PA as informants.

Merola and his involvement in Caribbean political activities, particularly concerning Cuba and Panama, during the late 1950s and 1970s. title: Caracas Station Cable Regarding Ricardo Morales and Letelier Investigation
summary: This document discusses concerns about Ricardo Morales, potential connections between Orlando Bosch and the assassination of Orlando Letelier, and related investigations.

title: MATLACK, DIECTHEK. (MRS) LEASE DOCUMENTS
summary: Collection of documents related to defectors to Chile and other topics such as: workers housing, transportation appropriation, teachers strike, copper situation, forsign ministry, emigration plan, press fieldga committee, coal situation, Chamber Presidential line-up, Gath y Chavez closing, immigration program, naval apponents, fishing strike, U.S. pastor, mining tax, housing construction, hydroelectric plant, chilean swedish trade, pipeline, industrial expansion, Disposal Questionnaire, Interagency Defects.

title: McLENDON, GORDON 201-79764
summary: This file contains documents related to Gordon Barton McLendon, including memoranda, security clearances, and name checks. The documents cover topics such as McLendon's potential as a witting collaborator, his business interests, and security investigations conducted by the CIA.

title: OBYEDKOV, IVAN DMITRIYEVICH
summary: This file contains information on Ivan Dmitriyevich Obyedkov, a Soviet guard at the Soviet Embassy in Mexico City and Tehran. The documents include outgoing messages, cables, and dispatches regarding Obyedkov's activities, possible intelligence affiliation, and traces requested by liaison. The file also contains information about Obyedkov's family, including his wife and son.

title: Colombian Police Report on Clandestine Arms Traffic in Costa Rica
summary: This document contains a report from a Colombian investigator regarding illicit armament traffic in Costa Rica in 1950. The report details the involvement of American citizens and Communist elements in the arms trade and suggests measures to improve Costa Rica's detective capabilities.

title: Cover Status of Luis POSADA Carriles (201-300985)
summary: This memo discusses the cover status of Luis POSADA Carriles, specifically regarding his employment with RECE and CACT, and requests that his resignation from Gri-State Engineering Service be recorded.

title: Application for Housing and Credit Reference with Tri-State Engineering
summary: A letter regarding an application for housing, credit references, and employment verification with Tri-State Engineering Service, Inc.

title: Cover for Luis POSADA Carriles and Alberto de Jesus ALBERTY Garcia
summary: This memorandum outlines cover arrangements for Luis POSADA Carriles and Alberto de Jesus ALBERTY Garcia with Tri-State Engineering Service, Inc., including their acknowledged positions, salaries, and the company's background for cover purposes.

title: Action and Status Cover for Luis POSADA Carriles and Alberto de Jesus ALMATO Garcia
summary: This memo discusses action and status cover for Luis POSADA Carriles and Alberto de Jesus ALMATO Garcia, recently assigned to the Carriles Training Base. It requests Tri-State Engineering cover for POSADA and notes ALMATO's existing cover with Radio & Electronics Equipment Company, Inc.

title: LUXE 0097: Opium Trafficking from Hong Kong to the United States
summary: This cable discusses Armand Delacour, a three-time convict, who approached the subject with an offer related to opium trafficking from Hong Kong to the United States. Delacour stated that two Sicilians living in Paris were already involved in this traffic, receiving opium from the Chicoms for delivery in the US. The subject also provides a physical description of Delacour.

title: Investigation into Albert Larrain Maestre and AMCLEVE/15's contact with Frank Rosenthal
summary: This collection of documents pertains to the CIA's investigation into Albert Larrain Maestre and his alleged involvement in bombings with Rosenthal, as well as his connections to narcotics. The documents also delve into AMCLEVE/15's (Luis Clements POSADA-Carriles) contact with Frank "Lefty" ROSENTHAL, and his cooperation with the FBI in the investigation of Frank Rosenthal. It includes queries from the Department of Justice, and explores the possibility of using AMCLEVE/15 to assist Rosenthal in obtaining additional materials for an arrest.
