summary: This cable identifies James Earl Ray as the accused assassin, providing his physical description, aliases, and criminal history. It also mentions that photos of Ray are being pouched for liaison.

title: Information Concerning Suspect in Martin Luther King Jr. Assassination
recipient: ASUNCION, BANGKOK, BARCELONA, BEIRUT, BERLIN, BERN, BOGOTA, BRASILIA, BRUSSELS, BUENOS AIRES, CXADOXAS, COPENHAGEN, FRANKFURT, GENEVA, GEORGETOWN, GUATEMALA CITY, GUAYAQUIL, THE HAGUE, HAMBURG, HELSINKI, HONG KONG, KINGSTON, LA PAZ, LIMA, LONDON, MADRID, MANAGUA, MONTEVIDEO, NEW DELHI, LISBON, MANILA, MUNICH, OSLO, PANAMA CITY, PARIS, PORT AU PRINCE, PORT OF SPAIN, PORTO ALEGRE, QUITO, RECIFE, RAWALPINDI, RIO DE JANERIO, ROME, SAN JOSE, SANTO DOMINGO, SAN SALVADOR, SANTIAGO, SANTIAGO DE LOS CABALLEROS, SAO PAULO, STOCKHOLM, TEGUCIGALPA, TOKYO, VIENNA, ZURICH
summary: This cable discusses Eric Starvo Galt, an alias of Harvey Lowmyer and John Willard, who is suspected of assassinating Martin Luther King, Jr. The cable provides a physical description of Galt and requests that addressees determine if Galt is or has been in their area.

title: Reinaldo PICO Ramon Information and Operational Approval
summary: This document contains information about Reinaldo PICO Ramon, including his travel history, visa requests, and connections to Latin American Christian Trade Unions. It also includes memos regarding operational approval for his use and requests for information.

title: HAVA 5939: IGUACIO HAD NOT LEFT HAVA AS PLANCED
summary: This cable discusses Nicolas Mendoza informing HAVASTA that his brother, Ignacio, had not left Havana as planned, and now plans to remain in Havana a few more days in hopes of obtaining permission from the Cuban government to leave legally.

title: Contact Report on Meeting with AMRUNG-1
summary: This memorandum details a meeting with AMRUNG-1 regarding operations in Cuba, including discussions on security, operational expenditures, W/T operators, support for anti-Castro groups, and key individuals involved in the counter-revolutionary movement. It also covers attempts to supply the ANTUM group with arms and ammo, and air-maritime operations currently being planned.

title: DIR 09095: Request for Biographical Data and Information on Individuals
summary: Requests biographical data for POA on Juan Estevez Ramiros and provides information for crafted Ambaro, Uirera Valdes, Morffi Machado, Ros Perez, and Fernandez Betancourt.

title: HAVA 0693: Intelligence Report from Havana, December 1958
summary: This cable details intelligence gathered in Cuba in December 1958, including the movements of Ernesto Guevara, the replacement of labor officials by the 26th of July Movement, Manuel Ray's visit to Fidel Castro, FEU activity in Matanzas, and Batista's hiring of French guerrilla warfare advisors.

title: GYROSE/AMCONCERT-1 Report on Cira MARTINEZ
summary: Report on Cira MARTINEZ, a confidante of Manuel Ray, including information about her connections, political views, and activities, as well as lists of potential defectors from the Castro regime and trained personnel in Cuba.

title: DISPATCH Chile
summary: This dispatch discusses the debriefing of an individual (Subject) removed from CAC. The debriefing focused on his relationship with Cuba and other security organizations. The subject claimed no relationship with Cuban C-2 but admitted knowing Ramiro VALOI. He was granted asylum in Uruguay in 1962. The subject also admitted to criminal activities in Los Angeles and involvement in an attempt to take items out of the country in April 1961.

title: STATEMENTS OF MANOLA RAY, EXILE LEADER OF THE PEOPLE'S REVOLUTIONARY MOVEMENT
recipient: STATE ARMY/ACSI NAVY AIR JCS SECDEF NSA NIC LISIA OCI ONE OCR ORR OD EXO FBI &NS TREASURY REPC INCLANT
summary: Telegram regarding statements of Manola Ray, exile leader of the People's Revolutionary Movement, who opposed invasion of Cuba and believed Castro's overthrow would be achieved by internal resistance. Ray claimed the MRP was organized throughout the island and supported by all classes, with members in trade unions, G-2, militia and administration. Ray estimated that 80% of the population opposed Castro.

title: STATEMENTS OF MANOLO RAY
summary: This cable discusses statements of Manolo Ray, with the DOI (Date of Information) being October 1961. The information comes from an official British service source with good contacts among exiles in Caracas. No separate cable distribution is being made of the TDCS.

title: PARI 9068: RAY CONTACTS AND PLANS
summary: This cable discusses Ray's contacts in Paris, including Jervay, Unrumble 6, Unpapist, and Alberto Brez Vito. It also mentions Cabrera's potential work on Arcos, Kubark staffer's interactions with Ray, and Ray's confidence in Franqui joining his camp. The cable further details Ray's plans to identify disaffected elements in Cuba and build a supply apparatus. It also includes Ray's requests for a list of Cuban embassies, training in a specific system, and a job for Cabrera.

title: Classified Messages Regarding Ray's Contacts and Activities in Europe
summary: This document contains classified messages regarding Ray's contacts and activities in Europe, including discussions with individuals like Jervay, UNRUMBLE 6, and Cabrera. It also mentions Ray's efforts to recruit individuals for potential operations against Castro, his interactions with a KUBARK staffer, and his plans to identify and support disaffected elements within Cuba's embassies and officialdom.

title: IN 47827: Obtaining Mexican Visa for AMBANG/1
summary: This cable discusses the difficulty of obtaining a Mexican visa through official channels due to bureaucratic delays and concerns about Cuban immigrants becoming public charges. It suggests alternative methods, such as using high-level Mexican contacts or Cuban friends with connections, and coordinating with the LITEMPO visa channel. The cable also advises on handling inquiries from the Mexican consul in Miami and using a CINODACID cover role.

title: Radio Switch Equipment for Demolition Firing Purposes
summary: This memorandum discusses radio switch equipment for demolition firing purposes, recommending companies like Motorola and Kell for reliable equipment. It also mentions the use of VHF/UHF frequencies and crystal tuning control for reliability. Inexpensive equipment from Japanese or American manufacturers is also mentioned for short range communications.

title: Meeting with AMBANG-1
summary: Memorandum regarding a meeting with AMBANG-1 on July 27, 1963, in Miami. Discusses requests for high explosives, contact in Guantanamo, political plans, isolation of Cuba, phasing out of employment, JURE radio link, aerial maps of Cuba, JURE organization and strength, questions about ARTIME, a list of Cuban diplomats, relation with Jorge Volsky, two-man underwater craft, training in a simple scorch system, an article for Cuadernos, and communication between AMBANG-1 and the case officer.

title: Cables regarding activities in Central America and identification of individuals
summary: This document discusses a meeting between ODACID POLIT officer Michael H. Martuffi and IOS, an engineering consultant, regarding Natolo Ray's training effort in Costa Rica. It also mentions IOEN's knowledge of Central American situation, his connection to Manolo Ray, and a boat he bought in Puerto Rico. The document further identifies IDEN as Zachary De Caster of Smith and Gillespie FUCISEFES, Jacksonville, Florida.

title: ROBATIC YOBITE AMBANG
summary: This cable discusses AMBANG-1's plans to travel to PBRUMEN (likely Cuba) and coordinate actions with individuals there. It details travel arrangements, including boats, meeting points, and personnel involved. The cable also mentions AMBANG-1's interactions with TIME Magazine and potential disinformation efforts.

title: Liaison Re: PERIMETER Group in Bavaria
summary: Report regarding Subject Resistance Group information in Bavaria, sent under separate cover, per request KMW 8907.

It covers personnel assignments, travel, and communications between Cuban officials and other parties.

title: Shipment of Explosives to Mexico
summary: Report on a shipment of explosives to Mexico for the Communist Party of El Salvador, involving Manuel PINEIRO and Rogelio RODRIGUEZ Lopez.

title: Owner of Auto Bearing California License HW 810 (How Mexican Diplomatic Plates D-136)
summary: Memorandum regarding the owner of a vehicle bearing California license HW 810, possibly displaying Mexican diplomatic plates D-136, which is registered to Camilo Domenech Gadea, former Commercial Counselor of the Cuban Embassy, and still used by the Cuban Embassy.

title: Classified Message 6
summary: Intelligence report detailing activities of Ernesto Guevara, the 26th of July Movement, Manuel Ray, FEU, and Batista's contracting of French military officers.

title: AQUATIC/Operational SW Supplies for AYTRE
summary: This document contains a routing sheet and a dispatch regarding supplies and instructions for two-way SW correspondence with AMIRE 1. It details the materials needed, instructions for their use, and security precautions for the agent.

title: Emilio Americo RODRIGUEZ
summary: This memorandum details the recruitment of Emilio Americo RODRIGUEZ by the Habana Station at a rate of $300.00 per month, effective 1 June 1960. It requests that Finance Division deposit the monthly salary into a specific bank account under the name of Emilio Rodrigues, with the first deposit to be made on 30 June 1960. No taxes are to be withheld from the salary.

title: Cable regarding exfiltration from Cuba and security concerns
summary: Cable discusses the need for individuals to leave Cuba, potential security risks (ELVIKA JOVANE DE SAYAS), and communication protocols. It also mentions financial arrangements and potential alternate communication channels.

title: Classified Message Regarding Security Concerns and Operations
summary: Cable discusses potential security breaches, Clinton's possible involvement, and counter-revolutionary activities.

title: MEXI INFO BELL CITE WAVE 4342
summary: This cable discusses statements made by Luis Alberto de Jesus Condo (Cajisal) to MEXI. It mentions individuals who handled Bobby Maduro and Juan Mendez, and suggests if the subject desires travel, AMOTS will assist him.

title: IN 2645: PRITY SELL INFO PRITY WAVE CITE MEXI 754 JMEIP SECUR
summary: Cable from Mexico City regarding Luis Alberto de Jesus Condom Cajigal rejoining the anti-communist underground and his involvement with the FRD.

title: Cable Regarding Contact with Mr. Free to Rodrigue and Message from Son
summary: Cable discussing a request to contact Mr. Free to Rodrigue. Conzales, an instructor at Berlitz School, and relay a message from his son Filio, who was recently arrested and released, advising him not to return to Cuba.

title: ANIC 3-1 Arrest on 3 March 1961
summary: This memo discusses the arrest of ANIC 3-1, an agent in Cuba, and the potential damage to operations. It details the information ANIC 3-1 possessed regarding stay-behind nets, agents, counter-revolutionaries, and cached funds.

title: SEFLATS SVEN ATTACCA-6710 Information
summary: Document regarding Juan I. Cessnova Koiriguez, possibly related to SEFLATS SVEN ATTACCA-6710.

title: Operational/CYPOCE/AIRECALEN/FOX WT Operator Candidate Inside Target Area
summary: This dispatch discusses a WT operator candidate recruited in Havana in the fall of 1960. The candidate was trained but never activated, and Headquarters is requested to review files to ascertain the subject's identity and whereabouts to determine if he could still be used operationally inside the target area.

title: Cover for AMIRE/1
summary: This memorandum outlines a cover arrangement for AMIRE/1, an individual employed by Roberts Electronic and Engineering Service as a consultant. The cover is designed to provide employment and credit references while ensuring proper tax reporting. The memo also requests notification when the cover is no longer needed.

title: Classified Message regarding CENTER SECTEMIC and SCTRICAL ESTIM
classification: John F. Kennedy Assassination Records Act of 1992
summary: This document appears to be a classified message regarding CENTER SECTEMIC and SCTRICAL ESTIM for action at PALLARS YEAR. It mentions priority cover statue.

title: Cover for Subject
summary: This memo discusses a devised cover for a subject, employed by Roberts Electronic and Engineering Service as a consultant in the Southeastern United States. It details the cover firm's information, payment procedures via bank transfer, and tax responsibilities, including the issuance of a U.S. Treasury form 1099. The memo also requests notification when the cover arrangement is no longer needed for proper backstopping.

title: Cables Regarding Potential Contact with AMAUTO-1 and Cuban Embassy Protests in Spain
summary: This document contains cable traffic related to potential contact with AMAUTO-1, a Cuban official, through various means, including using Manuel (Vigos) Perez, AMAUTO-1's cousin, and a tourist approach by SAMKO. It also details Cuban embassy protests in Spain over alleged attacks on Cuban officials.

title: Possible DRE Animus Towards President Kennedy
summary: Memorandum discussing possible animosity of the DRE (Student Revolutionary Directorate) towards President Kennedy due to his handling of Cuba, and the DRE's potential connection to Lee Harvey Oswald.

title: KEYWAY/PBRUHEX/SMOTE 01 Cuban Identified and suspect Intelligence
summary: Dispatch from London Station regarding a list of identified and suspect Cuban intelligence officers compiled from SMOTE records. Requests clearance to distribute the study to friendly Latin American and Western European liaison services and ODENVY.

title: Alastair Wickes Mercenary Activities and Associations
summary: These documents primarily concern Alastair Wickes, a mercenary involved in various activities, including recruiting for Tshombe's forces in the Congo, participating in plots to overthrow Mobutu, and potential involvement in Yemen. The documents detail his connections with other mercenaries like Mike Hoare and Jack Malloch, as well as his recruitment activities and associations with various organizations. There are also cross-references to other files and individuals.

title: Michell Livingston WERBELL - C-78785
summary: This memorandum discusses the Central Cover Division's (CCD) concurrence in a proposal to use Michell Livingston WerBell for a specific purpose, with the requirement to promptly advise CCD upon activation.

title: Call from Mr. Dick Philips (State) Regarding the Arrest of AMLEO-3
summary: Memorandum regarding the arrest of AMLEO-3, Jose Ricardo RABEL Nunez, and related information about Mitchell L. WER-BELL.

title: DIR 75462: AMWHIP Visit to Rome
summary: Cable regarding AMWHIP's visit to Rome during the week of October 13, 1963, and contact plans. It also includes routing and file information.

title: Potential Assets for Operations in Italy Targeting PERUNEN
recipient: DOP, CI, CI/OPS, CI/OA, CCS 2, FI, SAS 8, RF 2
summary: This document discusses potential assets for operations in Italy targeting PERUNEN, focusing on AMHIP 1 and other candidates like CHAS FOA and IDEN C. It addresses their suitability, access, and potential risks, including contamination of reputations and the need for cover stories.

title: CLASSIFIED MESSAGE
summary: This cable discusses an activation effort for a DRAGON agent in PBRUMEN (likely a code name). It requests information from SHITHAM ASIC AMWHIP about a letter sent to "THOMPSON'S FRIEND" in PBRUMEN and mentions key individuals like THOMPSON, WALLACE A. GROWERY, and AMTHIP.

title: Cable regarding Karin Espinosa and Miguel Angel Espinosa Bravo
summary: Cable regarding Karin Espinosa and her husband Miguel Angel Espinosa Bravo, a former Cuban ambassador to Norway, including information about his background, defection from the Castro government, and involvement in anti-Castro activities.

title: DIR 44488: AMWHIP/1 Visit to Rome
summary: This cable discusses AMWHIP/1, a KUBARK asset, who will be in Rome and is willing to provide services to the STA, including cover for PERUMEN operations. It recommends establishing contact with AMWHIP/1 to discuss various operational possibilities and problems, including cover for SUBJ DIR 38810.

title: Identifiers of FEP
summary: This document identifies several individuals and businesses, including Carlos Tepedino Gonzales, Juan Ventura Valker, Tisiman and Lipp Inc., and Carletto Inc.

title: DIR 62066: Study ON CUBAN TRANSPORT System.
summary: Cable regarding a study on the Cuban transport system, requesting that the study be obtained and forwarded to headquarters. It also discusses the approach for obtaining the study, whether openly or clandestinely.

title: Subject of 201-720615
recipient: Chief of Station, Rio de Janeiro
summary: This memo discusses a subject (Quenit Siegel) who applied for a tourist visa to the United States and requests that ALEHIP-1 debrief him on his PERUEN contacts and set up a contact in Rio de Janeiro if he appears operationally useful.

title: Proposed Operation and Equipment Considerations
summary: This cable discusses a proposed operation involving unretrievable equipment and the potential risks to liaison equity. It explores alternative possibilities such as inductive tapping and the use of non-attributable batteries. The cable also requests information from Rome regarding available equipment and batteries.

title: AMWHIP/1 Business Trip to Europe, including KUBARK errands
summary: Cable describes AMWHIP/1 arriving in Europe for a business trip including KUBARK errands in Paris and Geneva. They will arrive in Rome around May 5 and contact the station for any services needed.

title: Availability of AMWHIP for Operations in Geneva, Paris, and Rome
summary: This cable discusses the availability of AMWHIP for upcoming operations in Geneva, Paris, and Rome. It details AMWHIP's current commitments in New York and suggests alternative arrangements involving AMWHIP/2 for assistance in Rome prior to AMWHIP's arrival.

title: Meeting with Colonel Porres Saturday, 10 October 1964
summary: Memorandum regarding a meeting with Colonel Porres concerning special treatment for individuals involved with Lyon Sosa, Luis Augusto Turcios Lima, Manuel Joue Ortega Paz, and others who received guerrilla warfare training in Cuba. Discussion also includes the Alfaro case, Luiz Ramirez case, and Hector Jordi Chambonyer case.

title: AMIMUG-1 Operation 24: Briefing in Guatemala of Chief of State (Peralta)
summary: Briefing with Guatemalan Chief of State Peralta regarding intelligence cooperation, security, and concerns about Cuba and Mexico. Peralta expresses his views on Castro, U.S. policy, and the need for aggressive action.

title: DIR CITE SALV 5312
summary: Cable discusses JUNAVE 1, LANGOSCH, AMMLUC 1, Cuban Intel, and potential recruitment efforts.

title: CLASSIFIED MESSAGE
summary: Cable discusses the recruitment of JUAVE 2, security considerations, and other targets.

title: CLASSIFIED MESSAGE
summary: Cable discusses a meeting between PESVING Chief and LANGOSCH, where LANGOSCH briefed on DGI operations and organization, including information on various individuals. LOPEZ expressed keen interest and promised cooperation.

title: AMMUG/1 Operation: Target Analysis and Non-surfacable Leads
summary: This memorandum discusses AMMUG/1 Operation, target analysis, and non-surfacable leads. It includes lists of Central American and Caribbean nationals whose names have come up during debriefing, as well as Target Analysis Summary Reports on individuals like Francisco Javier HELLA Pena and Roque DALTON Garcia. The memo also details operational leads and vulnerabilities for recruitment or defection.

title: DYVOUR/PBRUMEN/Operational: Photograph of "Comandante Willian"
summary: This dispatch requests the photograph of "Comandante William" be shown to AMBINGOs for possible identification. Subject claimed to have received pilot training at San Antonio de los Banos Air Base and may have worked as a Cubana pilot under the name Ernesto Castro Moro.

title: SANTO DOMINGO 2564: DISCUSSIONS BETWEEN CUBANS AND MAIJA REPS
summary: This cable discusses discussions between Cubans and MAIJA reps, including topics such as the PICHI MELLA case, the "GRUPO FRANCES," and concerns about GENAO. It also mentions documents confiscated from a Dominican communist courier.

title: Message Regarding AMMUG/1 and Inter-University Committee
summary: This document is a message from the Director to JMWAVE regarding the Inter-University Committee for Political and Social Action and the purchase of a home for AMMUG/1. It also mentions Langosch's request for AMMUG/1 services in Frankfurt.

title: JMWAVE 4480
summary: This cable discusses AMMUG/1, an agent, and their cover status. It mentions a change in cover to meet tax requirements and facilitate a house purchase.

title: Covert Training for SIFA Officers
summary: This document details a request for covert training for Venezuelan Armed Forces Intelligence Service (SIFA) officers. It outlines the training requirements, biographical data of the trainees, and the purpose of establishing a liaison relationship with SIFA to improve its capabilities and recruit a member.

title: Operational Notes and Case File Information
summary: This document contains a series of operational notes, case file information, and summaries related to various agents, plans, and contacts. It includes details about recruitment, training, communication methods, and operational objectives within the context of covert activities.

title: Operational Activities related to AMMUG/1
sender: WH/MIAMI; Madrid Station; The Hague Station; Leasing Officer
summary: These documents concern operational activities related to AMMUG/1, including travel arrangements, liaison with foreign agencies, and requests for watchlisting individuals of interest. Specific individuals mentioned include Roberto Rodriguez Llompart, Eugenio Gonzalez Alvarez, and others involved in Cuban commercial activities in London.

title: Amendment to Operational Approval for AMMUG/1
summary: Operational Approval for AMMUG/1 is amended to authorize operational use outside the United States as set forth in PRQ Part II dated 13 February 1965, per memorandum request of 31 December 1970.

title: WAVE Plans and Training
summary: This cable discusses WAVE plans to start training ALICE INFILS EAR and contains personal information, including names and dates of birth, of several individuals: DANILO POZO CASTRO, EUSTIQUIANO GARCIA LEZCANO, MIGUEL A. DIAZ ISALCUE, OSCAR OLIVA CANTUD, JUAN ESPINOSA GONZALEZ, and FRANCISCO DOMINGUEZ ELEJALDE. It also requests POAS subjects and a card set and discusses JESUS RIERA FERRO as a candidate for RADOP.

title: Letter Regarding Employment for Migration Study
summary: This letter from Roger Joyce of the Community of Nations Fund to Miguel A. Diaz Isalgue confirms an agreement to employ Diaz at a rate of $250.00 per month, commencing March 1st, to study the effect of large-scale migration on communities, particularly in the Miami area due to the influx of Cuban countrymen.

title: Candidate for Contact with PACETTE
summary: This cable discusses a candidate mentioned in a previous reference (REF A) who is not intended for travel to Havana as per another reference (REF B), but rather for contact with PACETTE only. AMWHIP-1 was unable to find a candidate in time for the Havana trip mentioned in REF B. The cable also mentions deferring involving AMWHIP-1 with PACETTE pending the outcome of STATION attempts at contact.

title: Meeting with AMBUNNY-1 and AMWHIP-1
summary: Memorandum regarding a meeting with AMBUNNY-1 and AMWHIP-1 to discuss a possible operation involving the penetration of UNSNAFU-19 office. Concerns are raised about AMBUNNY-1's background and the risk it poses to AMWHIP-1's connections. The possibility of using a cutout is suggested. A planned operation in Paris is canceled, but AMBUNNY-1 may be utilized in Rabat.

title: Contact Report, Meeting with AMWHIP-1
summary: Report on a meeting with AMWHIP-1 regarding the possibility of placing AMBUNNY in UNSNAFU-19's mission in Paris as a French-English-Spanish speaking secretary. The meeting covered AMBUNNY's qualifications and the potential difficulties in concealing her background. The author also reflects on AMWHIP-1's personality and approach to problem-solving.

title: RE: ZRRIFLE
summary: This memo discusses the transfer of QJWIN to Baden-Baden, candidates spotted by QJWIN in Italy, and a spotting effort through Hank Manfredi in Rome. It also covers details of contact with QJWIN, drawing funds, and an emergency contact.

title: NAME CHECK, DOCUMENT SERVICE, AND PARTIAL CONSOLIDATION REQUEST
summary: This document is a NAME CHECK, DOCUMENT SERVICE, AND PARTIAL CONSOLIDATION REQUEST form related to Lamberto BESTA. It contains information about BESTA's aliases, occupation, date and place of birth, citizenship, and residence. The form also includes checking instructions and comments regarding pertinent identifiable information and background use. Additional information about BESTA's activities, including collaboration with DEMIGOD, involvement in contraband traffic, and attempted double agent operation, is also provided.

title: ZRRIFLE
summary: This memo discusses the transfer of QJWIN, candidates spotted by QJWIN, and other spotting efforts in Italy and France.

title: RELOVA
summary: This document contains personality information on (fnu) RELOVA, pseudonym "Wilberto," an officer of the Direccion General de Inteligencia (DGI) in Cuba. It includes details about his residence, travel history, and personal characteristics, as well as information from a former Cuban Intelligence officer.

title: Julian NOVAS Fernandez
recipient: DIA, NAVY, AIR, I&NS, NSA, REP CINCLANT CINCSO
summary: Report on Julian NOVAS Fernandez, identified as a Cuban Intelligence Officer, with details on his assignment in Kingston, Jamaica, as Commercial Attache.

title: JOSE FERNANDEZ
recipient: STATE, DIA, ARMY, NAVY, AIR, NSA, OCR, FBI, REP, CINCLANT, CINCSO, I&NS
summary: Report on Jose Fernandez, also known as 'El Gallego,' detailing his roles in the Cuban military, his history, and his perceived political leanings.

title: Guillermo ARASTAGUIA
recipient: DIA, ARMY, NAVY, AIR, OCR, FBI, REP CINCLANT, CINCSO, LENS
summary: This document contains personality information on Guillermo ARASTAGUIA, pseudonym "Rene," chief of the Department of Technical Operational Support (MI) in the Direccion General de Inteligencia (DGI). It includes details about his background, physical description, and possible connections to Anibal ESCALANTE and Ramiro VALDES.

title: IS AMUG-1 DEBRIEFING (SPANISH VERSION) FORWARDED
summary: Cable regarding IS AMUG-1 debriefing and forwarding of Spanish version, requesting guidance on passing a copy to COL ARRIAGA and sending an additional copy for station retention.

title: Safehouse #405
summary: This memorandum details the requisition and establishment of Safehouse #405, including its location, lessee, cover story, case officer, and financial arrangements.

title: Rent Reminder to Mr. Roger Shea
summary: This document is a rent reminder from SUMIT HILL PROPERTIES, INC. to Mr. Roger Shea, regarding overdue rent for August 1, 1964.

title: RECEIPT FOR AUTHENTICATION MATERIALS
summary: This document is a receipt for authentication materials related to Ernesto Jesus GARCIA Guzman, including his Ecuadorean and Cuban documents.

title: Memo for the Records: AMMUG Transfer to New Apartment
summary: Memo regarding the transfer of AMMUG to a new apartment in Silver Springs, Maryland. The apartment was not ready upon arrival, and lacked essential amenities. Arrangements were made for the installation of a telephone.

title: Laddie's Housing Situation
summary: Memo regarding Laddie's housing situation, including payment balance and apartment arrangements at Summit Hill Apartments.

title: SAFEHOUSE FOR AMMUG-1
summary: This memo discusses the procurement of a safehouse for AMMUG-1 at Summit Hill Apartments in Silver Spring, Maryland. It details the arrangement made with John Ryan, the placement of a deposit on apartment G-32, and the notification of security. Roger Shea will sign the lease under the name Vladimir Rodriguez Lahera, starting July 1, 1964.

title: MEMO FOR THE RECORD
summary: This memo discusses the status of AMMUG-1's INS card and arrangements for AMMUG-1 to move into a safe apartment at Summit Hill, including lease arrangements, moving assistance, and purchasing linens.

title: COVERT SITE Apartment G 32 Summit Hills Apartments.
summary: This document discusses the security approval and survey of a covert site located at Summit Hills Apartments in Silver Spring, Maryland. It details potential security hazards, communication systems, fire and police protection, and biographical data of residents in nearby apartments.

title: RECEIPT FOR AUTHENTICATION MATERIALS
summary: This document is a receipt for authentication materials related to Jaime Sanchez Papo (Alias). It acknowledges the receipt of a Mexican Driver's License and a Mexican Voters Certificate.

title: REJECTION OF AN APARTMENT FOR AMMUG-1
summary: This memo discusses the rejection of an apartment for AMMUG-1 due to exposure to KUBARK staffers and agent assets, including Mr. Dolf Luim, Mr. (Mike Kline), (Horace Speed), and Lou De Santi. It requests that another apartment be secured for AMMUG-1.

title: Memorandum for the Record: Safehouse for AMMUG-1
summary: This memorandum discusses the decision to use a specific safehouse for AMMUG-1, located at Hunting Towers, Mt. Vernon Blvd. Apt. #731-West, Alexandria. It outlines the agreement with Mr. (Ray Scofield), the inspection of the apartment, and the plan to move A-1 into the safehouse after debriefing. The memo also mentions informing Mr. (John Ryan) about the change in plans regarding prospective apartments for A-1.

title: DIR 20506: KURIOT PREPARING TWO DOCUMENTS
summary: Cable discussing the preparation of two documents for a case, including a driver's license and voter registration, and instructions for forwarding them to a specific address.

title: MEXI 9336: RYBAT TYPIC AMMUG
summary: Cable discussing a plan involving a MEXI officer carrying a letter and instructions to MNTY, and the preparation of MEXI identity documents. Also includes a C/S comment about AMMIING-1 wanting to write to his wife in Cuba.

title: Potential Visit of AMMUG-1 to Montevideo and Support for Intelligence Unit
recipient: DIRECTOR INFO SANTIAGO JMWAVE RIO DE JANEIRO
summary: This cable discusses the potential visit of AMMUG-1 to Montevideo for a presentation and its potential impact on convincing the need for YM support for the newly created Directorate of Intelligence Unit. It also mentions the return of AVALANCHE officers from WOFIRM training.

title: COS Station List 1964
summary: List of COS stations and locations as of 1964.

title: SAN SALVADOR 6756: Recruitment and Interrogation Operations
summary: This cable discusses the recruitment and interrogation of individuals, including Jose Rehberto Carrillo Calderon and Alejandro Gonez Montano, for joint operations against POEs. It also mentions potential involvement of AMMUG-1 and JUSLOOP-1 in these operations.

title: IS AMUG-1 DEBRIEFING (SPANISH VERSION) FORWARDED HGGW-3947
summary: Cable regarding AMUG-1 debriefing and forwarding a Spanish version to Col Arriaga.

summary: This document contains policy guidance directives for Cuban intelligence representatives in the Dominican Republic, prepared by the General Directorate of Intelligence (DGI), MA Department, during the régime of Juan Bosch Gaviño. It outlines priorities and information guidelines for intelligence gathering in Santo Domingo, focusing on collective action against Cuba, the status of leftist forces, the Dominican Republic Armed Forces, the Dominican Communist Party, training camps, counterrevolutionary organizations, repressive corps, CIA activities, political parties, solidarity with Cuba movement, relations with the United States, the Church, and the internal situation of the armed forces.

title: Fernando FUENTES Coba
recipient: STATE, DIA, ARMY, NAVY, AIR, NSA, XXX, OCR, FBI, REP, CINCLANT, CINCSO, I&NS
summary: This document contains information about Fernando FUENTES Coba, a former lieutenant in the Cuban Police Force who later worked in a printing establishment in Halifax, Canada. The report includes supplemental information from the CIA records regarding FUENTES' involvement with the Departamento Tecnico de Investigaciones (DTI) and his activities related to forging birth certificates and serving as a Castro agent.

title: (fnu) RELOVA
recipient: STATE, DIA, ARMY, NAVY, NSA, OCR, FBI, REP CINCLANT, CINCSO
summary: This document is an information report from the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) regarding (fnu) RELOVA, an officer of the Direccion General de Inteligencia (DGI) in Cuba. The report includes details about RELOVA's residences, travels, and activities, gathered from various sources and supplemented by CIA records.

title: Julian NOVAS Fernandez
recipient: DIA, ARMY, NAVY, AIR, NSA, OCR, FBI, I&NS, CINCLANT, CINCSO
summary: Report on Julian NOVAS Fernandez, identified as a Cuban Intelligence Officer, including details of his assignment to the Cuban Consulate in Kingston, Jamaica, as Commercial Attache, his background, and his wife's arrival in Kingston.

title: Policy Guidance Directives for Cuban Intelligence Representatives in Haiti
summary: This document contains policy guidance directives for Cuban intelligence representatives in Haiti, prepared by the General Directorate of Intelligence (DGI), MA Department.

title: Policy Guidance Directives for Cuban Intelligence Representatives in the Dominican Republic
sender: General Directorate of Intelligence (Direccion General de Inteligencia--DGI)
summary: This document outlines policy guidance directives for Cuban intelligence representatives in the Dominican Republic, prepared by the General Directorate of Intelligence (DGI). It prioritizes information gathering on collective action against Cuba, the status of leftist forces, the Dominican Republic Armed Forces, the Dominican Communist Party, training camps, counterrevolutionary organizations, repressive corps, CIA Santo Domingo, political parties, solidarity with Cuba movement, relations with the United States, the Church, and internal situation of the armed forces.

title: AMMUG/1 Identification of Manuel ESTEVEZ Perez
recipient: Chief of Station, Madrid; Chief of Base, Barcelona; Chief of Station, JMWAVE
summary: This dispatch concerns the identification of Manuel ESTEVEZ Perez by AMMUG/1. AMMUG/1 was unable to identify the name. It suggests providing a photograph of the subject to HAVE to show AMMUG/1 for possible identification.

title: Cable regarding Cuban Defector and GAN Trainees
summary: This cable discusses the approach to a Cuban defector, Rivera, and concerns about surfacing names of GAN trainees due to potential risks and lack of juridical grounds. It also recommends deletions and adjustments to a draft CAS paper regarding Cuban aggression planning and proposes a course of action involving arrests and the presentation of evidence to the OAS.

title: Request for LISTAN Project Renewal
summary: This memo requests the renewal of the LISTAN Project, adjusting the budget to reflect the new policy of charging Staff Agent costs to Station Support.

title: Photographic Surveillance Operation
summary: This file contains documents related to KDFACTOR, a photographic surveillance operation targeting the MHHARSH installation in Mexico City. The documents include operational reports, cable messages, and administrative information. The operation involved multiple surveillance points (KDLITERAL and KDABSINTHE) and several salaried assets. The file covers the period from 1958 to 1973, detailing the project's activities, security measures, and eventual termination.

title: Amendment and Termination of Project KDFACTOR
sender: L. A. Campbell, Chief, Foreign Intelligence
summary: This document pertains to Project KDFACTOR, a photographic surveillance operation in Mexico City targeting the Soviet Embassy. It discusses the termination of the project due to a security breach, agent terminations, and associated costs, requesting additional funding to cover expenses.

title: LIENVOY Operations - Monthly Operational and Production Reports; Personality Briefs
summary: These documents pertain to Project LIENVOY, a sensitive intelligence operation. They include monthly operational reports, production reports, and personality briefs. The reports cover target lines, processing of information, exploitation of leads, liaison activities, security, technical issues, personnel, and production metrics. Noteworthy individuals such as Lazaro Cardenas del Rio and David Alfaro Siqueiros are profiled. The documents also discuss interactions with Cuban and Soviet officials and operations against various targets including embassies and political figures.

title: Intelligence on POES Activities and Concerns
summary: This document discusses meetings and intelligence related to the POES (Communist Party of El Salvador), including potential risks of discovery and the need to maintain operational security. It mentions individuals involved in the POES and their activities, as well as concerns about security leaks and potential damage to relations. The document also outlines actions taken to gather information on guerrilla warfare and other activities.

title: CUBAN DEFECTOR: Briefing in Guatemala (Chief of State Peralta)
summary: This memorandum discusses a briefing in Guatemala regarding Cuban defector operations, DGI structure and operational techniques, and potential cooperation between the U.S. and Guatemala in intelligence matters.

title: Classified Message Regarding Cuban Target and Intelligence Activities
summary: This classified message discusses meetings with a Cuban target and a Cuban defector, intelligence gathering efforts, and concerns about security leaks and potential compromise of CIA operations. It also covers topics such as PCES activities, recruitment of individuals, and the disappearance of Roque Dalton.

title: Recruitment of Cuban Target in El Salvador
summary: This document details a CIA operation involving the recruitment of a Cuban target through the cooperation of a Salvadoran intelligence chief. It outlines the importance of the target's knowledge of communist parties in El Salvador and other Central American countries, and the security measures in place to protect the operation.

title: DIR 52099: ALTERNATIVE UNDER CIRCUMSTANCES
summary: Cable discusses potential alternative under certain circumstances, mentioning CUBA SLUBAN DETECTOR and RAFS SALY MOLEX 5296.

title: Cuban Defector
summary: This cable discusses the handling of a Cuban defector, referred to as DALTON. It assesses his potential value as an agent against Cuban intelligence and the obstacles he presents if released. It also covers the protection of equity in a Cuban target, recruitment efforts, and the arrest of guerrillas trained in Cuba.

title: DIR CITE SALY 5329 WH DIV CUBA CUBAN DEFECTOR
summary: This document discusses matters related to a Salvadoran asset and a Cuban exile asset. It mentions discussions with NIGHT 38, arrangements for DALTON, and plans for a return after a stop. It also includes routing and handling information.

title: Briefing on Cuban Subversion
summary: Cable regarding briefing to the President concerning Cuban subversion and use of material, emphasizing the need for professional handling and security.

title: Salv 5289: WH DIV CUBA CUBAN DEFECTORS
summary: Cable discusses a plan to move DALTON to a house where a CIA officer can see him alone and verify a cutout story through PLA.

title: Intel Service Chief LIGIBON to attend President Rivera's briefing
summary: This cable discusses the importance of the Intel Service Chief LIGIBON attending President Rivera's briefing, as he will likely try to move in on leads and take full credit for the Cuban defector information.

title: STAFF EMPLOYEES WILL TRAVEL SALV
summary: This cable discusses potential meetings and discussions in El Salvador and Guatemala regarding Cuban subversion, as well as potential pitches to AMMUG leads.

title: Transmittal of Debriefing Report on use of Fraudulent International Travel Documentation by Cuban Intelligence
recipient: Chief of Station, London; Chief, Frankfurt; COS, Germany
summary: Transmittal of Debriefing Report on use of Fraudulent International Travel Documentation by Cuban Intelligence. Cena 4819.

title: Traces of Individuals and Travel Watchlist Request
summary: This cable discusses traces of individuals, including Roque Dalton Garcia, Rogelio Rodriguez, Julio Damas Vasquez, FNU Sosa, Alejandro Gomez Montano, and Ricardo Martinez, and requests advice on disclosing names to Panamanian authorities for travel watchlist purposes.

title: Various documents related to Project KDAFGHAN and related operations in Mexico City
summary: This collection of documents primarily concerns Project KDAFGHAN, a photographic operation conducted in Mexico City. The documents cover various aspects, including equipment requests (specialized lenses, cameras), passport renewals for KDAFGHAN personnel, technical issues with pulse cameras and related equipment, file management procedures (opening, amending, closing files), cryptonym changes, and audit reports. Mentions of LIONION, AQUATIC, and other related operations are interwoven. Also included are administrative notices concerning file processing and retirement.

title: DIR CITE SALV 5229: WHDV CUBA CUBANDEF
recipient: DDP, WILSA 8, CI, Cilops, ciles, VE
summary: This cable discusses the approach to a liaison asset (Tapy/Watson) and details a refusal to serve as an informant due to security concerns. It mentions potential work with someone enjoying close relations with a cultural attaché. Instructions are given to delay further action until advised, and a request is made to identify a representative mentioned in a previous reference.

title: MOC, Christian Democracy in Latin America, Plans for ODCA Mid-April Congress
sender: Chief of Station, JMWAVE; William V. Brocc
recipient: Chief, WH Division; Chiefs, All MI Stations and Bases
summary: This document discusses the Organizacion Democrata Cristiana de America (ODCA) Congress, Christian Democracy in Latin America, and European CD support to CD parties.

title: Setting Off of Bombs by Juventud Accion Cubana Anticomunista
summary: Cable regarding Cuban youth plans for sabotage on 30 April by JUVENTUD ACCION CUBANA ANTICOMUNISTA.

title: DIRECTOR BELLA NAPELI
summary: This cable discusses Orlando Bosch's suspended sentence, allegations of WOFACT activities, and potential publicization of JMWAVE activity.

title: Miami Herald Article on Manuel Ray Replacing Miro
summary: This document discusses an article in the Miami Herald that claims Manuel Ray has replaced Miro as exile chief with the blessing of the United States. The article has caused concern in the local Cuban colony, and the CIA is considering discrediting the story and reassuring Miro.

title: STATEMENTS OF MANOLA RAY, EXILE LEADER OF THE PEOPLE'S REVOLUTIONARY MOVEMENT
summary: Statements of Manolo Ray, exile leader of the People's Revolutionary Movement, regarding the overthrow of Castro and the role of internal resistance.

title: Debriefing Report - Santiago SANCHEZ de la Torre
summary: Debriefing report on Santiago SANCHEZ de la Torre, detailing his work against the CASTRO regime, his involvement with the MRR, and information regarding the MRR roll up. Includes information on Angel BENCOMO, believed to be responsible for the MRR roll-up.

title: Terence S. CRABANAC Contract Employment Records
sender: Chief, Contract Personnel Division and various other CIA offices
summary: This collection of documents pertains to the contract employment of Terence S. CRABANAC with the CIA from 1965 to 1970. It includes contracts, amendments, and memoranda regarding his compensation, allowances, travel, operational expenses, benefits, and cover activities. Key topics include his assignment to Spain, housing allowances, royalty retention, and transition from staff employee to contract employee.

title: REDWOOD/LCIMPROVE: Semen Spiridon POHORILYJ and Jozef KOZAK Investigations
sender: Chief of Station, Paris/Vienna; Deputy Director (Plans)
recipient: Director, Federal Bureau of Investigation; Chief, SR; Chief, WE; Chief, EE
summary: This file contains dispatches and FBI documents related to Semen Spiridon Pohorilyj and Jozef Kozak. The documents discuss investigations into their activities, contacts, and potential connections with Soviet intelligence.

title: DE GOLYER CO.
summary: This document references DeGolyer & MacNaughton and photogeological mapping in the Spanish Sahara.

title: Location and Code List for Divisions and Operations
summary: Lists of locations and codes related to various divisions and operations.

title: THE LEE HARVEY OSWALD CASE
summary: This memo discusses Abram Chayes, Llewellyn Thompson, and Samuel Wiese's alleged involvement in Lee Harvey Oswald's return to the United States from the Soviet Union in June 1962. It also details security clearances, associations, and investigations related to these individuals.

title: RELEASE UNDER THE PRESIDENT JOHN F. KENNEDY ASSASSINATION RECORDS ACT OF 1992
summary: This document is a memo regarding the Top Secret study entitled, "The Examination of the Bona Fides of a KGB Defector - Yuriy I. NOSENKO," dated February 1968. It details the attachment of specific pages, deletion of sensitive information, and a request for the study's return after review. The memo also warns of sensitive intelligence sources and methods involved.

title: PBQ Part I - Alfonso Dabilodox Torres
summary: Dispatch from the Chief of Station, Mexico City to Chief, WH Division regarding PBQ Part I on Alfonso Dabilodox Torres. Requests provisional operational approval and a 201 number. Includes assigned cryptonym.

title: LIENVOY-8
summary: This dispatch discusses LIENVOY-8, a person believed to have been terminated from the LIFEAT and LIENVOY project but still covered by the LIEKVOY Project. Headquarters requests information on the present status of LIENVOY-8, including whether he has been terminated or is still being used, and if so, an analysis of his reliability and any security problems.

title: Related Mission Directive for Mexico
summary: This memorandum discusses the revised Related Mission Directive for Mexico. It outlines the long-range national policy objectives of the U.S. Government toward Mexico, operational emphasis on clandestine collection and covert action operations, and changes in the MAD. The directive includes objectives related to obtaining information on Sino-Soviet bloc activities, reducing Communist influence, obtaining information on the Communist Party of Mexico, and supporting efforts against the Castro regime in Cuba.

title: The 201 System
summary: This document describes the 201 system used by the Operations Directorate for identifying, controlling, and filing information on persons of interest. It covers 201 numbers, dossiers, master records, OI codes, machine lists, dossier creation, maintenance, restrictions, information requests, and cancellation procedures.

title: RESTRICTIONS ON OPERATIONAL USE OF CERTAIN CATEGORIES OF INDIVIDUALS
summary: This document outlines restrictions on the operational use of certain categories of individuals by the DDO. It details prohibitions and policy restrictions based on U.S. Governmental directives, agency agreements, and the DDO's risk assessments. It includes guidelines for approval procedures when using individuals from sensitive categories, such as members of ACTION, Fulbright grantees, media employees, and foreign nationals.

title: House Select Committee on Assassinations Request for Information on 201 Criteria (S)
summary: This document discusses the 201 system, which is a method for identifying persons of interest and controlling information about them. It includes details on opening, maintaining, controlling, and closing 201 files, as well as the use of OI codes and machine listings.

title: GENERAL- Administrative, SPECIFIC- Arthur G. VAIVADA
summary: This document discusses Arthur G. Vaivada's request for reassignment from Habana in June 1958, including his interest in being assigned to Spain under unofficial cover and the Station's recommendation for his reassignment.

title: Request for Domestic Cover for Ross Crozier
sender: Chief, SAS; Desmond FitzGerald; Chief, SAS/Support; Board J.
recipient: Central Cover Staff; Chief, Central Cover Staff; Chief, Finance Division
summary: These documents relate to the request for domestic and military cover for Ross Crozier, including reasons for the request and updates on his location and duties.

title: MEXI 5444: REDWOOD LCIMPROVE SPOT APPROACH TO BAKULIN
summary: This cable discusses potential assets for accessing Valentin Vasilyevich Bakulin and requests traces on Arturo Carrillo Esparza and Cynthia Chlebicki.

title: Medical Information and Activities in Cuba
summary: This report details information obtained from various sources regarding medical supplies to Cuba, film purchase requests, and personnel listings. It includes bulletins from anti-communist groups, letters concerning film purchases from Czechoslovakia, and commentary from Cuban medical figures.

title: BARNES, WINIFRED C.
summary: This file contains interoffice memorandums, security messages and information reports pertaining to Winfred Clark Barnes and his activities. The documents detail security checks, biographic data, clearance requests, and his employment history with Esso and International Petroleum Company. The reports also cover topics such as anti-Castro attitudes of ICP personnel, operations of refineries, and oil-related issues in Cuba.

title: Request for Training at ISOLATION
summary: This cable details a request for training for a six-man leader group at ISOLATION, scheduled to arrive on July 11. The training will focus on isotropics, with less emphasis on UDI, stress leadership, and field exercises encompassing tradecraft, caching, and observation reporting. All trainees have completed JMWAVE training and have OA's and recent LCFLUTTERS. The cable also requests airlift for the leader team to ISO on the night of July 11 and return of the AMANCHOR group from ISO to WAVE on the night of July 12.

title: Training Report for FRANK - PBRUMEN II
sender: JEROME W. GREINER, Project Officer, Chief Instructor (JOSEPH M. HUDACEK)
summary: This document is a training report for student FRANK in paramilitary resistance activities and intelligence collection operations, covering the period from July 11 to August 13, 1966. It includes performance evaluations and narrative comments on FRANK's skills and capabilities.

title: DIR 48198: Keyway PBRUMEN AMWHIP
summary: Cable regarding an activation effort to a DRAGON agent in PBRUMEN, who met in Paris by THOMPSON and WALLACE A. GROWERY last summer. Request for SMITHAM to ask AMTHIP for date he sent letter to "THOMPSON'S FRIEND" in PBRUMEN.

title: PREPARATION OF OUTGOING SW MESSAGES
summary: This document is a letter to AMLASH/1, which discusses a number of topics, including the possibility of AMLASH/1 returning to military service, the need for more detailed information in reports, a potential meeting in Mexico, and the location of hiding places in Paris. The letter also requests information on Soviet medical clinics in Cuba, reports of Soviet citizens becoming ill, shipments of bad meat from the Soviet Union, and reports of cattle in Cuba being infected with foot-and-mouth disease.

title: Director 627921
summary: This cable discusses the Department of State authorizing visas to the AMLASH family, with a proviso that they are bona fide visitors and not immigrants. It also includes a debriefing of AMLASH-1 in Madrid, where he expressed his intention to settle in Spain. The file number is 201-252234.

title: NINTEL ANLASH
summary: Cable regarding AMLASH/1 (Cuban asset) in Madrid, meeting with a representative, and future plans. Request for contact information for IDEN B upon arrival in Madrid.

title: Visit of Identities
summary: This dispatch discusses Identities A and B. Identity A is willing to serve ODYOKE without remuneration and has been in contact with the local attache regarding aeronautical spare parts. Identity B has been in contact with another ODYOKE component since January 62 and therefore cannot be approached by KUBARK.

title: Report of PBPRIME Citizen on Connections with Ecuadorean Government
recipient: Chief of Station, Quito; Chief of Base, Guayaquil
summary: Report of PBPRIME Citizen on Connections with Ecuadorean Government, Subject's statements and activities in Ecuador

title: I. IRVING DAVIDSON
summary: This memo discusses I. Irving Davidson, an international businessman, and his potential involvement in business propositions, as well as his contacts with various government agencies and foreign representatives. It also mentions his relationship with Drew Pearson and MIRAVELIN and his activities related to arms sales and travel agencies.

title: TYPIC/Operational Transmittal of Operational Plan for ANTRUNK VII
summary: Operational plan for ANTRUNK VII, involving infiltration into Northern Matanzas Province and Havana to accomplish MHAPRON objectives. The plan includes establishing contact with ANTRUNK-10, recruiting Jose Alberto SEMIDEY Isalgue, and caching a clandestine radio set.

title: Improved Sight for 7.62 Belgium (FAL) Rifle
summary: This memorandum details the provision of improved sights for the 7.62 Belgium (FAL) rifle, including rear sight hoods, instructions, tool kits, and ammunition. It notes the infeasibility of developing a scope and mount within the given timeframe and provides contact information for additional details.

title: Tests of Modified Sights for 7.62 Belgium (FAL) Rifle
summary: This memorandum details tests conducted on modified sights for the 7.62 Belgium (FAL) Rifle. The tests involved a Williams Peep sight and a telescopic sight, with the aim of improving the rifle's accuracy and range. The tests revealed issues with both sights, including erratic performance and mounting difficulties.

title: Communication Details for Rolando CUBELA Secades
summary: This document details communication methods and addresses for contacting Rolando CUBELA Secades, including standard, rapid, and emergency options. It also specifies code names and procedures for secure communication.

title: 250661 13 192 TO PARIS FROM DIRECTOR
summary: Cable discusses traces of CANTO and refers to RYBAT.

title: Test of Open Sight Hood for 7.62um Belgium (FAL) Rifle
summary: This memorandum details tests conducted on an open sight hood for the 7.62mm Belgium (FAL) Rifle, including tests of improved underloaded 7.62mm NATO rounds, listener trials to determine the distance at which the rifle's mechanical noise could be discerned, and an evaluation of the sight hood's fit on various rifles. It also covers the use of a scope in low light conditions and the delivery of sight hoods and ammunition.

title: AMLASAL
summary: Cable discusses Manuel Cantillo Toirac, new second secretary at the Cuban Embassy in Madrid, who is reportedly connected to Cuban Security, and the development of a close friendship with Cantillo.

title: TYPIC/WHAPRON/ANTRUNK/Operational ABSTRACT: ANTRUNK Progress Report for Period 1-30 November 1964
summary: This dispatch reports on the progress of ANTRUNK operations for November 1964, including preparations for ANTRUNK X, recruitment efforts, and communication with assets. It also details operational expenditures and projected plans for future operations.

title: DIR 95504: UNSKAPU/9 Firing and Potential Hazard to AMLASH/1
summary: This cable discusses the potential hazard of UNSKAPU/9 firing to AMLASH/1 and suggests methods to determine the background of UNSNAFU/19's statement about U/9 being a "dirty KUBARK agent." It proposes using AMWHIP/1 and his jeweler friend in Havana, Jose Iglesias, to relay information to ANLASH/1.

title: PEAT TYPIC AMLASH
summary: This cable discusses the AMLASH operation and the involvement of AMWHIP/2. It suggests minimizing contact with AMWHIP/2 until Joseph Langosch can provide background information.

title: Meeting with AMLASH-1 in Paris, 31 January to 3 February 1965
summary: Memorandum detailing a meeting with AMLASH-1 in Paris from January 31 to February 3, 1965. Topics discussed include security implications related to the capture of Modesto Orlando Orozco Basulto, resupply of S/W developer pills, upcoming FEU elections, precautions for sabotage of locomotives being shipped from France to Cuba, and information on Cuban Intelligence Service personnel and other Cuban officials.

title: MEMORANDUM FOR THE RECORD SUBJECT: Clemard Joseph CHARLES
summary: This memorandum details contacts and assessments of Clemard Joseph Charles, a Haitian banker, by various US agencies. It discusses his connections to President Duvalier, his political ambitions, and his interactions with US officials. The memo also mentions George de Mohrenschildt and his background.

title: Cable Regarding Communication from Cuban Prison
summary: This cable discusses Lazaro Gutierrez Menoyo's note from a Cuban prison to Pedro M. Diaz in Miami. It also mentions Eloy Gutierrez Menoyo and traces on Diaz.

title: CLASSIFIED MESSAGE
summary: This cable discusses Richard Gibson, former secretary of the 'Fair Play for Cuba Committee,' and his alleged misuse of office. It also mentions the magazine 'Revolution' and efforts to buy up copies.

title: CONTACT REPORT #11
summary: Report on a meeting held on January 25, 1963, concerning Kulpa's trip to the Congo, instructions to Meinturff, Serge Michel's agreement to use K.K.'s photos for a new trique Revolutionaire (I), and contact from Gibson regarding Dave Watts' request for photos. Also includes accounting matters and the schedule for the next meeting.

title: Project Outline: Support for Singleton Contract Agent Operating in Right-Wing Political Milieu in Mexico
summary: This document outlines a project to support a U.S. contract agent (LIHUFF/1) operating in Mexico City, focusing on intelligence gathering and covert action related to right-wing political elements in Mexico. The project aims to provide insights into the stability of the Mexican government and potentially contribute to MHSPAWN objectives. It details the agent's background, objectives, operational assets, security considerations, and budget.

title: NIKOLAY STEPANOVICH LEONOV Travel Information
summary: Cable regarding NIKOLAY STEPANOVICH LEONOV's travel plans from Mexico City to Brussels and potentially Moscow, including flight details and requests for confirmation.

title: Classified Message Regarding Subject's Political Beliefs and Visit to China
summary: This document is a classified message regarding a subject described as leftist but anti-communist and strongly anti-American. The agency wants to develop information on his current political beliefs and why the subject wanted to visit China. They want to evaluate answers to determine his ability to provide intel, with a view toward recruiting him for a briefed mission or residence in China. The message also discusses the possibility that the subject may have been asked to carry back messages, money, or perform other services in Mexico by the Chinese communists.

title: ANUPAS-1 Incident in Guatemala
summary: Cable details the arrest and expulsion of ANUPAS-1 from Guatemala for attempting to transport Coxie propaganda. ANUPAS-1 tried to enter Guatemala on November 3, was denied entry, returned on November 7, arrested on November 8, and expelled to Mexico on November 8. The arrest received press coverage.

title: Director to Tokyo: Investigation into Martin Contacts and Potential Soviet Intelligence Connections
summary: This document discusses Martin's contact with Dr. Jakob Y. Fischer, Yuri Rastvorov's female contact, and potential Soviet intelligence connections in Tokyo. It requests traces on John Joseph Casey, Joseph W. Jason, and Major Paul Rochelle, and inquiries about Burris's presence in Tokyo.

title: William Hamilton Martin and Bernon Ferguson Mitchell
summary: This collection of documents discusses William Hamilton Martin and Bernon Ferguson Mitchell's desire to leave the USSR and potential assistance from Canadian professor Dr. Hans Kunov.

title: Georges Papanton MITCHELL; Anastasia Martini DAKARJIN, Espionage – R.
summary: Memorandum regarding Georges Papanton MITCHELL, Anastasia Martini DAKARJIN, and Nicolas Georges DAMASCOU aka DAMASCUS aka DAMARCON aka RAMASCUS, focusing on their travel history, visa applications, and current whereabouts.

title: Person Ferguson MITCHELL, William Hamilton MARTIN, Espionage-R
summary: This memorandum from the CIA to the FBI concerns Person Ferguson MITCHELL, William Hamilton MARTIN, and Espionage-R. It discusses information related to Nicolas Georges DAMASCUS, Justo SIERRA Casasus, and their potential connections to Soviet intelligence officers, including Boris A. KAZANTSEV, and the escape route used by NSA defectors, transiting Mexico and presumably Cuba en route to the USSR.

title: MEXI 8621: JMZIP RYBAT - BARBOSA Tomar
summary: This cable discusses a plan to establish a clandestine radio station in Mexico, named "RADIO CUBA LIBRE," to communicate with a sabotage team in Cuba. LITAMIL-5 is tasked with contacting LIOOZE-1 in Havana and delivering a code book to "JESUS BADAL," who is in contact with KUBARK PBPRIME. The radio transmitter was received as a gift, and LITAMIL-5's voice will be used for the broadcasts.

title: MACHADO Llosas, Manuel
summary: Report on Manuel MACHADO Llosas, a Cuban exile in Mexico who was a member of the 26th of July group and is now a CIA agent (LITAMIL-1).

title: POSADA, LUIS CLEMENTE
summary: This file contains information on Luis Posada Carriles, including polygraph results, requests for investigation, and operational approvals.

title: Classified Message Regarding Unidentified Subject
summary: This message discusses the inability to identify a subject, requesting more information. Mentions KEYWAY PBRUMEN UNRUMBLE and references PARI 1548.

title: Transmittal of Letters Sent to Movimiento Democrata Cristiano Representative in Cuba
summary: Transmittal of letters sent to Movimiento Democrata Cristiano representative in Cuba concerning Jose Ignacio RASCO's connection with the HDC, obtained by AMULLA-1 for duplication and delivery via the Italian Embassy's diplomatic pouch.

title: Cable Regarding AMULLA-1 and Information Security
summary: Cable discusses concerns regarding AMULLA-1 and potential risks to future operations due to his handling of information. It outlines plans to implement stricter controls on materials obtained from AMULLA-1 to protect sensitive information.

title: HUS TRACKS INDICATE SURJ REF HAS BHEN UNDER ODENVY INVESTIGATION
summary: This cable discusses an investigation into possible registration act violations by a subject in Santiago de Cuba. It also mentions Frank Fiorini of Norfolk, VA, who claimed to be an arms buyer in Miami and willing to cooperate with information on rebels.

title: FELIPE VIDAL SANTIAGO
summary: Report on FELIPE VIDAL SANTIAGO, a Cuban refugee involved in anti-CASTRO activities in Miami, Florida. Subject defected from the CASTRO government while employed as Cuban Naval Attache in Caracas, Venezuela.

title: TYPIC/OPERATIONAL Special Activities Report on JMWAVE's Relationship with AMCARDON-1
summary: This dispatch reports on JMWAVE's relationship with AMCARDON-1, including operational support, intelligence, and propaganda activities.

title: Contract Information and Check List and Contract Agreement for Bruce G. Mastrocola
summary: Contract agreement between the United States Government and Bruce G. Mastrocola for confidential information and related services, detailing compensation, travel, operational expenses, secrecy obligations, and terms of agreement.

title: Personnel Actions related to Floryan Karty
summary: Personnel actions related to Floryan Karty's reassignment to Mexico City and Bangkok. Includes salary adjustments, official disability claim notices, and creditable service documentation.

title: JMWAVE 4480: AMMUG/1 Employment and Background
summary: This cable discusses the employment and background checks of AMMUG/1, including their cover status, salary, and attempts to purchase a house locally. It also mentions issues with informing WOGAME about employment changes and requests early acknowledgment to expedite the house purchase.

title: Yuriy Ivanovic NOSENKO
sender: David E. Murphy, Chief, SR Division
summary: Memorandum for record regarding Yuriy Ivanovic NOSENKO, discussing plans for hostile interrogation and concerns about potential consequences.

title: Memorandum of Visit to: Julio Pablo RODRIGUEZ Reyes
summary: Memorandum regarding Julio Pablo Rodriguez Reyes, a member of the United Revolutionary Movement (URM), who arrived in the US as an exile and may have information of interest. He provided details on URM's structure, leaders, and activities, including contacts with a Catholic Chaplain and involvement in supplying radio transmitters to anti-Castro guerrillas.

title: Briefing of Mr. Maurice Oldfield, MI-6, by WR/4, Clark Simmons
summary: Memorandum regarding a briefing of Mr. Maurice Oldfield, MI-6, by WR/4, Clark Simmons concerning Robert Horton Geddes and his contacts with the CIA regarding potential Cuban Navy defection.

title: Reactions from WH to UR Propaganda and Desire to concentrate UR efforts on PSYWAR
summary: This dispatch discusses reactions from the White House to propaganda efforts and the desire to concentrate efforts on PSYWAR. It notes that additional effort by the UR to influence foreign audiences will be highly valued.

title: PLANNED UPRISING BY OPPOSITION GROUPS IN CUBA
summary: This document discusses a planned uprising by opposition groups in Cuba. Members of the UNIDAD REVOLUCIONARIA (UR) reported to the French Embassy in Habana that they were invited to a meeting organized by the DIRECTORIO REVOLUCIONARIO ESTUDIANTIL (DRE) and the MOVIMIENTO REVOLUCIONARIO DEL PUEBLO (MRP) to plan a stage of active warfare. The UR was advised not to participate, but the DRE and MRP planned an uprising for the last days of August, which would result in a general uprising of all internal resistance groups.

title: IN14497: GYROSE INTEL - Potential Uprising in Cuba
summary: This cable discusses intelligence regarding a potential uprising in Cuba. It suggests that while information points to a planned revolt, there's a strong possibility it's a deception or provocation operation by Castro's forces. Various exile groups are mentioned, and their involvement is investigated, with most denying knowledge of the planned uprising. The cable concludes that a genuine popular uprising is unlikely at the time and arranges for a broadcast to warn Cuban patriots about potential provocations.

title: Attempted R.I.S. Penetration of Bell Telephone Labs
summary: This document discusses an attempted RIS penetration of Bell Telephone Laboratories and concerns about CI Staff's reaction to a request for assistance in defensive briefing of a subject.

title: Transcription Analysis of 11 June 1962 Tape
summary: This document details the methodology used to transcribe a portion of a tape from June 11, 1962, involving Nosenko. Multiple professional Russian transcribers were tasked with transcribing the tape, focusing on specific phrases where previous transcriptions indicated Nosenko had claimed to be in the United States and used the alias Nikolayev in both England and the United States. The new transcriptions consistently indicated that Nosenko stated he had used the alias Nikolayev in England and the Soviet Union ('u nas').

title: Report on Conversation Involving Dr. Aureliano SAN Romani
summary: A dispatch reports on an APOT source, Eduardo NUNEZ Garcia, who overheard a conversation involving Dr. Aureliano SAN Romani regarding a trip to Panama and Guatemala, where San Romani discussed creating a junta and expressed opinions about various political figures.

title: Comments Concerning KUBARK Aftermath of Cuban Operation
summary: This cable discusses the aftermath of the Cuban operation, focusing on press and congressional commentary regarding KUBARK and other activities in the ODYOKE area. It addresses misinformation, reviews of the operation, and ongoing intelligence briefings to Congress.

title: Meeting with Dr. MIRO Cardona on 6 October
summary: Memorandum for the record of a meeting with Dr. MIRO Cardona discussing propaganda campaigns, underground activities, commando plans, requests for arms, information on arms received by Castro regime, a proposal for the Council to go to Cuba and establish a government on Cuban soil, views about judges and lawyers, members of the Revolutionary Council, probable Argentine rupture of relations with Cuba, attendance to Homage to LACERDA, Propaganda Commission, views relative to Supreme Court Justice or PRIO being recognised as Head of a Provisional Government, offices of Council, and coordinating the activities of other exile groups.

title: Report on Cuban Operations for Period 1-15 September 61
sender: J. C. KING, Chief, Western Hemisphere Division
summary: This memorandum summarizes Cuban operations from September 1-15, 1961, detailing FI-CI activity, propaganda efforts (including Operations Bolivar and Virgen del Cobre), political action related to the Cuban Revolutionary Council (CRC), paramilitary activities, training, communications, and support. It includes information on agent activities, broadcasts, leaflet distribution, periodical publications, tours, and financial obligations.

title: ANTI-FIDEL CASTRO ACTIVITIES INTERNAL SECURITY - CUBA
summary: FBI memo regarding anti-Fidel Castro activities, reporting that Guatemalan Ambassador Carlos Alejos contacted Miguel Ydigoras-Fuentes regarding Jose Miro Cardona's desire to meet and apologize for a missed meeting.

title: KNGS 0208: JAMAICAN POLITICAL CLIMATE RE ESTABLISHMENT AMBUD DELEGATION
summary: Kingston station reports on the Jamaican government's stance on involvement in the Cold War and covert operations against Cuba, advising against overt involvement due to concerns for the Jamaican community in Cuba and potential loss of cooperation.

title: U. K. Liaison file
summary: U. K. Liaison file referencing LOND 5956 (IN 27353), 29 March 1961 and LOND 5963 (IN 28181), 31 March 1961. Cables to be opened by Chief, WH/A/PA only.

title: Report on Cuban Invasion at Cochinos Bay
summary: Report on the failed Bay of Pigs invasion, detailing rebel losses and factors contributing to their defeat.

title: REQUEST POA FOR VICENTE HERRERO DIAZ
summary: Cable discussing Vicente Herrero Diaz, a Cuban national in Panama, and requesting POA for him for use in local public opinion research, monitoring, and support of JMRAKE activities.

title: AMBUD Program Administration and Financial Management
summary: This collection of documents primarily pertains to the administration and financial management of the AMBUD program, specifically focusing on dependency payments and trust accounts managed by AMTIKI and MHMUTUAL. The documents include requests for account balances, instructions for terminating trust accounts, proposed payment plans, and the transfer of funds. They also discuss the handling of dependency cases, including those related to individuals killed during the Bay of Pigs invasion, and logistical arrangements for personnel travel to review AMTIKI files.

title: Cables regarding PBRUMEN Exiles and Manuel Perez Borroto
summary: These cables discuss PBRUMEN exiles in Miami and their proposed security proposals. It also mentions Manuel Perez Borroto, an ex-Batista police captain.

title: Analysis of Deposits for Expenses - July 1962
summary: Analysis of deposits for expenses out of the $81,500.00 budget for July 1962, including delegations, propaganda, clandestineness, and Judicatura Cubana Democrática.

title: GARCIA AND PAULA TRUST ACCOUNT
summary: Financial records detailing transactions within the 'Garcia and Paula' trust account, including payments to recruit dependents, transfers to savings accounts, and reimbursements.

title: PM Case Officers in Contact with Segments of the CRC
summary: This memorandum lists PM case officers in contact with segments of the CRC (Cuban Revolutionary Council), detailing specific officers and their contacts within the CRC, including Siro Cardona, Carlos Hevia, and others. It also mentions the release of this document under the President John F. Kennedy Assassination Records Act of 1992.

title: Meeting with Dr. MIRO Cardona on 6 October
summary: Memorandum for the Record regarding a meeting with Dr. MIRO Cardona on 6 October 1961, discussing propaganda campaigns, underground activities, commando plans, and the possibility of establishing a government on Cuban soil.

title: Meeting with Dr. Miro in New York City on October 16, 1961
summary: This memorandum details a meeting with Dr. Miro in New York City on October 16, 1961, where they discussed the situation in Cuba, including the suffering of Cubans under Castro, the need for his overthrow, and the role of the Consejo (CRC) in fomenting opposition. Miro expressed concerns about the lack of a central plan, the infiltration of people into Cuba without Council involvement, and the need for arms and money for clandestine groups. He also discussed propaganda efforts and the involvement of various individuals and organizations in the Cuban resistance movement.

title: JMZIP/Operational - Contact with Dr. MIRO Cardona
summary: Report of contact with subject written by Theodore F. PASSAVOY, and a memo of WH/4 comments, Meeting with Dr. MIRO Cardona on 6 October discussing propaganda efforts, commando action plan, request for arms for Escambray, information on arms received by Castro regime, proposal that Council go to Cuba with Commando Group and Establish a Government on Cuban Soil, views about judges and lawyers, members of the Revolutionary Council, probable Argentine rupture of relations with Cuba, MIRO to attend Homage to LACERDA (Brazilian who Precipitated QUADROS' resignation) on October 15, Propaganda Commission, MIRO's Views Relative to Supreme Court Justice or PRIO being Recognized as Head of a Provisional Government, Offices of Council (Consejo Revolucionario), MIRO's Views on Coordinating the Activities of Other Exile Groups, Telephone Conversation with MIRO on 7 October.

title: ROME 9301
summary: This cable discusses Delorry's arrival in Italy, ETA to Cuba, contacts with Annie de Quendoz, German Camado-Blanco, Rolio (Montenegro) Guasp, Saverio Tutino, Protestant clerics in Cuba, and Cubamb in Belgium.

title: DIR 83150: Locating AMTRUNK-9 and A-9
summary: This cable discusses attempts to locate AMTRUNK-9 and A-9 after possible capture in Cuba, and advises caution in contacting certain individuals who may alert Cuban authorities.

title: Cable Regarding BUENAVENTURA FRANCESCO (DELLUNDE) Y PUYANS
summary: This document is a cable regarding BUENAVENTURA FRANCESCO (DELLUNDE) Y PUYANS, a Cuban national who was assessed as willing to aid KUBARK.

title: ASSIFIED MESSAGE
summary: This cable discusses information acquired from ARMAND (MARTINEZ) Y VIRELLESI regarding MRR activity, a potential uprising in Cuba, and key individuals involved.

title: Cable Regarding AMLASH and APWHIP Activities
recipient: DOO, DOP, ADDP, C/WE Z, C/CI, C/FI2, VR, FILE
summary: Cable regarding AMLASH and APWHIP activities, mentioning contact in Miami and coordination efforts.

title: Communication Details for Rolando CUBELA Secades
summary: This document details communication methods and addresses for contacting Rolando CUBELA Secades (T/N: Rolando CUBELA Secades), a medical doctor in Havana, Cuba, in 1965. It includes instructions for forwarding letters through AMWHIP/2 and AMWHIP/1, as well as addresses for Srta Ernestina Acosta and Virginia Secades. It also specifies the use of 'Pepe' and 'Luis' signatures for secure communications.

title: Investigation into ACSI Involvement in AMTRUNK-9 Trip
summary: This document discusses an investigation into the potential involvement of ACSI (Army Counterintelligence) in sponsoring AMTRUNK-9's trip. It details circumstantial evidence suggesting ACSI involvement, including statements from AMTRUNK-9's wife, a written note from AMFAUNA-3, and the identification of the agent handler "Torres". The document also mentions concerns about funds provided for the trip and potential insubordination or misrepresentation within ACSI. It further explores the possibility of KUBARK sponsorship and discrepancies in the stories told by AMTRUNK-9 and his wife regarding the trip's funding.

title: TRANSMITTAL OF COPY OF MEMO REGARDING AMTRUNK-9 INFIL WHICH ACTION REQUIRED REFERENPASSED TO ACSI 19 JANUARY 1965
summary: Dispatch regarding AMTRUNK-9 infiltration into Cuba by Modesto Orlando Crozco Basulto to rescue Jose Vasquez Nerey and others, involving individuals named Jorge and Hortensia Orizondo Meneses.

title: Names from AMTRUNK, AMICE, AMFAUNA
summary: List of names under AMTRUNK, AMICE, and AMFAUNA, possibly related to the John F. Kennedy assassination investigation.

title: AMWEST/1 Recruitment and Potential Defection; Possible Provocation Attempt
summary: This cable discusses the recruitment and potential defection of AMWEST/1, contact between AMWESTs and AMWHIPs, and a possible provocation attempt involving Antonio Carrillo. It also mentions a Cuban exile named Juan Ventura Valner.

title: CASUGAR BON 90518
summary: Cable regarding CASUGAR/1, a high-level access PBRUMEN target personality. Requests OTTAWA to intercede with SMABOVEs for a joint debriefing in Canada.

title: Report on Purge in Cuba
summary: This cable reports on a widespread purge underway in Cuba of military officers, government officials, and Communist Party leaders. It also discusses the trial of Cubans for plotting to overthrow Fidel Castro and the resulting student reactions. The document analyzes the underlying causes of the purges and suggests potential PSYCH EXPLOITATION in media.

title: Possible Travel to Italy by PINEIRO
summary: This cable discusses DELORRY's interactions with Manuel (PINEIRO) Lozada and Saverio TUTINO regarding a potential trip to Italy. It includes information about phone calls, meeting arrangements, and travel plans involving individuals connected to Cuban affairs.

title: AMLASH/1 - Paris Station Aspect
summary: This document discusses Paris Station's involvement with AMLASH/1, including recruitment, training, contacts, and plans to assassinate AMPED. It details meetings, personnel involved, and the evolution of AMLASH/1's plans.

title: Arrangements for AMBUD-1 Visit & Robles Identification
recipient: WAVE INFO DIR MANA GUAT SALV TEGU SANJ
summary: Two classified messages, both dated 08 June 62. The first details arrangements for AMBUD-1's visit to PACY, including meetings and tours. It also mentions financing for BOCAL. The second identifies Marco Robles, Minister of Government and Justice.

title: GYROSE AMBUD
summary: COS believes Jamaican government wants not be overtly involved in Cold War.
